  • Understanding of healthcare data privacy, security, and HIPAA requirements.

Votre rôle

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons notre prochain talent :

Chef de projet implémentation H/F

Vous rejoignez l’une des huit équipes du Delivery de la Business Line E&P, qui compte environ 76 collaborateurs.

Vous pilotez des projets d’interopérabilité biomédicale et de déploiement de solutions EIE auprès d’établissements de santé. Vous êtes l’interlocuteur central de vos projets et veillez à leur bonne réalisation, dans le respect du budget, du calendrier et du périmètre vendu.

Votre mission contribue à la satisfaction des clients et à l’amélioration du quotidien des soignants, en garantissant des déploiements fiables et sécurisés.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

  • Piloter un portefeuille de projets, du lancement jusqu’à la clôture, en organisant votre activité et en priorisant les sujets.
  • Déployer les solutions EIE dans le respect des engagements contractuels, des budgets, des délais et du périmètre défini.
  • Être l’interlocuteur principal des clients et assurer la coordination des parties prenantes tout au long des projets.
  • Préparer et animer les réunions de cadrage, notamment pour les projets complexes, seul(e) ou avec l’appui d’un chef de projet implémentation.
  • Intervenir sur des projets complexes pilotés par la DPS et contribuer, le cas échéant, à des projets transverses, multi-BL ou internes structurants.
  • Assurer la gestion documentaire liée au pilotage des projets.
  • Suivre l’avancement, anticiper les risques et mettre en place les actions nécessaires au bon déroulement des projets.
  • Rendre compte de votre activité et de vos avancées à votre manager, notamment lors des réunions d’équipe hebdomadaires.
  • Contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs annuels de chiffre d’affaires et de satisfaction client.

Votre profil

Le profil idéal :

  • Vous disposez d’une expérience en gestion de projets, idéalement dans le secteur de la santé, des systèmes d’information ou de l’interopérabilité.
  • Vous savez piloter plusieurs projets en parallèle et organiser votre activité de manière autonome.
  • Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de la gestion de projet : cadrage, planification, suivi des risques, coordination, reporting et clôture.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans l’animation de réunions et la communication avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment des clients et des équipes techniques.
  • Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d’organisation et de réactivité.
  • Vous avez le sens du service et êtes attentif(ve) à la satisfaction client.
  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez collaborer dans un environnement transverse.
  • Une expérience de projets internationaux et la maîtrise de l’anglais seraient appréciées.

Entité

Filiale d’Orange Business, Leader français de l’interopérabilité médicale, Enovacom est un éditeur de solutions 100 % santé au service des professionnels de santé.

Notre but est d'améliorer leur quotidien à travers nos solutions d'acquisition, de protection, d’échange et d’exploitation des données de santé.

Plus particulièrement sur les domaines suivants : la télésanté, l’interopérabilité biomédicale, l’imagerie médicale, l’entrepôt de données de santé, l’interopérabilité.

Avec près de 600 collaborateurs en France et un développement international engagé au Canada, et en Europe, Enovacom travaille aujourd’hui avec plus de 3000 structures de santé quotidiennement.

Enovacom est une entité juridique de l’Unité Economique et Sociale d’Orange Business, qui vient d’intégrer dans ses équipes les sociétés Nehs Digital et Xperis et poursuit donc sa transformation afin de devenir un leader français de la transformation du système de santé grâce au Smart data & IA.

Confiance, engagement, collectif et excellence sont des valeurs qui guident notre quotidien et notre ambition.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAbout Quicklizard Quicklizard is a pricing intelligence and optimization platform for retailers and brands.
jobs.description:
Description

About Quicklizard

Quicklizard is a pricing intelligence and optimization platform for retailers and brands. Our SaaS helps pricing, category and e-commerce teams set the right price across products, channels and markets, using competitive data, business rules and AI-driven recommendations to grow revenue and protect margin.

We are growing our customer base across the US and Latin America and are building a local team to serve and win customers in the region.

The role

We are hiring a hybrid pre-sales engineer and customer success manager to cover the Americas. The split is roughly 50/50: half your time managing and growing our US and Latin America customers, half supporting the sales team on new opportunities across the region.

This is a remote role, based in Mexico or the US, reporting to the Director of Sales. You will work closely with Account Executives, our implementation and R&D teams, and product. Because you will sell and serve the same region, you own the full customer journey: from first demo to go-live, adoption and renewal.

What you'll do

Customer success (about 50%)

  • Own a portfolio of US and Latin America customers as their main day-to-day contact, from onboarding through renewal.
  • Lead onboarding and go-live: gather requirements, translate the customer's pricing logic into strategies and business rules, and coordinate data integration with our implementation and R&D teams.
  • Drive adoption: train users, spot underused capabilities, and recommend improvements to pricing strategies.
  • Run regular business reviews that tie Quicklizard's results to customer KPIs such as margin, revenue and price competitiveness.
  • Protect renewals by flagging risk early, and identify expansion opportunities (new categories, channels, countries or modules) together with the Account Executives.
  • Be the customer's voice internally, feeding requests and feedback to product.

Pre-sales (about 50%)

  • Partner with Account Executives on Americas opportunities, from discovery to signature.
  • Lead business and technical discovery: the prospect's pricing process, data sources, systems (ERP, e-commerce, POS) and competitive data needs.
  • Build and deliver tailored demos, workshops and proof-of-value environments, in English and Spanish.
  • Map prospect use cases to Quicklizard's pricing strategies, rules and integrations, and scope the implementation.
  • Own the technical and functional sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnaires.
  • Ensure a clean handover from sale to onboarding, so what we promise is what we deliver.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience across pre-sales or solutions engineering, customer success and account management, in B2B SaaS or retail technology.
  • A background in retail: you understand how retailers and brands manage categories, promotions, pricing and assortment.
  • Technical fluency: comfortable with data, data feeds, APIs and system integrations, and able to speak with both IT and business stakeholders.
  • Strong demo and presentation skills, with confidence in front of pricing managers, category managers and C-level executives.
  • Fluent professional English and Spanish, written and spoken.
  • Based in Mexico or the US, with the right to work there, and available for regular travel to customers and prospects in the region.
  • A self-starter who works well remotely, across time zones, and is comfortable building processes in a region we are still growing.

Nice to have

  • Pricing experience: as a pricing analyst or manager at a retailer, or with price optimization, revenue management or competitive price monitoring software.
  • Familiarity with retail systems common in the region, such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify or VTEX.
  • Hands-on data skills (advanced Excel, SQL or Python) to build demo data and analyze customer results.
  • Experience with AI or machine-learning based products.
  • Portuguese, for customers and prospects in Brazil.
  • Experience working with a CRM such as HubSpot.

Why join us

  • Shape how Quicklizard sells to and serves customers across the Americas, at an early stage of our growth in the region.
  • A role that combines commercial and technical work, with direct impact on both new revenue and customer retention.
  • Work with a global, experienced team in retail pricing.
  • Fully remote from Mexico or the US, with a competitive compensation package.

jobs.title: Credit Data Assurance Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Overview This is a remote role that will be hired in the Eastern Time Zone in the United States.
jobs.description:
Overview

This is a remote role that will be hired in the Eastern Time Zone in the United States.

This position serves as a strategic partner across Credit, Reporting, Data, Product, and Technology organizations, ensuring business, data, process, and system changes are effectively assessed for impacts to Credit Reporting and downstream reporting deliverables.

This role is responsible for performing complex business and data impact assessments, translating business requirements into actionable data use cases, leading data triage, and root cause analysis efforts, and driving improvements in data quality, data lineage transparency, and reporting readiness. The analyst will play a critical role in proactively identifying and mitigating reporting and data risks.

The successful candidate will possess strong credit domain expertise, advanced analytical skills, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across multiple organizations while independently leading strategic initiatives.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities:

Credit Reporting Impact Assessment

  • Perform portfolio-level impact assessments to identify reporting, data, and operational risks before implementation.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to ensure reporting requirements are understood and incorporated into change initiatives.

Business & Data Requirements Management

  • Translate business requirements into credit data use cases and actionable requirements for Product, Technology, and Data teams.
  • Develop business process maps, data flow documentation, and reporting requirements to support strategic initiatives.
  • Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.

Data Analysis & Data Assurance

  • Perform advanced analysis of credit and reporting data to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve transparency into data quality, data lineage, controls, and reporting readiness across the Credit Reporting ecosystem.
  • Support the design and implementation of processes that enhance data reliability and consumption confidence.

Data Triage & Issue Management

  • Lead data triage activities, root cause analysis, and issue prioritization across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Coordinate the resolution of data quality, reporting, and operational issues by partnering with business, technology, and data teams.
  • Escalate and communicate material risks and issues to senior stakeholders as appropriate.

Reporting Risk Management

  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate reporting and data risks before they impact downstream consumers or regulatory deliverables.
  • Evaluate control effectiveness and recommend enhancements that strengthen reporting accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • Support governance and risk management activities related to Credit Reporting and data management.

Strategic Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Independently lead cross-functional initiatives involving Credit, Reporting, Technology, Product, and Data organizations.
  • Influence decision-making by translating complex credit concepts into measurable business and data impacts.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on Credit Reporting, data risk, and reporting readiness matters.

Position Specific Skills:

  • Commercial Banking or Lending Operations Experience
  • Data Quality Management & Data Lineage
  • Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration
  • Data Analysis
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Risk Identification & Mitigation

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 4 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 8 years' experience in Analytics, or Modeling, or Reporting

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience assessing the impact of data, process, system, or business changes on reporting and regulatory deliverables.
  • Strong understanding of commercial lending, credit products, and the end-to-end credit lifecycle.
  • Experience with data lineage, data governance, data quality, and controls frameworks.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience analyzing large, complex datasets.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and leading issue remediation efforts.
  • Knowledge of regulatory reporting, reporting controls, or enterprise risk management practices.
  • Experience working across Credit, Technology, Data, and Reporting organizations.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and drive outcomes across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data transformation, modernization, or credit data initiatives.

Additional Information

This job posting is expected to remain active for 5 days from the initial posting date listed above. If it is necessary to extend this deadline, the posting will remain active as appropriate. Job postings may come down early due to business need or a high volume of applicants.

The base pay for this position is generally between $95,000 and $115,000. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment.

Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at .

This job requires a U.S. Person. A U.S. Person is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, or individuals granted refugee or asylee status in the U.S. are considered U.S. persons. For a complete definition of “U.S. Person” go here.

Security Clearance Type:

Required

Security Clearance Status:

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do

As an Account Specialist supporting the MESPC value stream, you will play a critical role in managing supplier relationships and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality products. You will lead cross-functional teams, manage supplier performance, and oversee the qualification and delivery of parts. Key responsibilities include:

  • Manage complex cold start product procurement and supplier relationships.
  • Oversee supplier monthly spares output to ensure timely and quality delivery.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to qualify parts and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to address and resolve quality or delivery issues.
  • Monitor and manage supplier performance metrics, including cost, quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and procedures.
  • Support strategic sourcing initiatives in alignment with long-term business objectives.
  • Identify and mitigate risks related to supplier performance and delivery schedules.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years experience
  • U.S. Person - Job requires access to ITAR or 600/500-series EAR information or hardware (directly or indirectly) and the company will not seek an export authorization for this role.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience in supply chain management, including procurement and supplier management.
  • Experience with project management processes and tools.
  • Experience managing supplier performance, including quality and delivery metrics.
  • 3 years of experience in procurement.

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:


Remote: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). If you live within a reasonable commute of an RTX site with other colleagues you interact with, your manager will discuss whether there is a degree of onsite presence associated with this role.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 86,800 USD - 165,200 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Security Administrator with a primary focus on security administration, audit support, policy management, and third-party risk oversight to maintain a continuous compliance posture against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, HIPAA, and related frameworks.

The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with strong project management skills, audit experience, and the ability to manage multiple security and compliance workstreams while supporting security leadership, privacy stakeholders, vendors, on-site security engineering teams, and independent assessment organizations.

This selected individual will support our SafeGuard Services (SGS) team, a subsidiary of Peraton, which performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review, to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse in Medicare/Medicaid healthcare programs.

What you'll do:

The Security Administrator will be responsible for the following but not limited to::

Security Compliance & Policy Management

  • Author, maintain, and update security policies, procedures, standards, plans, and control documentation for the SGS Contracts environment.
  • Perform control testing and gap analysis against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, HIPAA/HITECH and the CMS ARS and PIM.
  • Document deficiencies and manage the Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) lifecycle from identification through verified closure
  • Respond to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEVs), CCIC bulletins, and compliance data calls

Audit & Assessment Support

  • Support maintenance of the control evidence library and GRC platform records, control mappings, and compliance reporting using CFACTs.
  • Serve as the operational-side evidence provider for annual independent assessments and CMS reviews.
  • Support Security Assessment preparation and security assessment report development
  • Ensure audit-readiness on any given day rather than reconstructed compliance

Third-Party & Vendor Risk Management

  • Conduct vendor security due diligence and assessments.
  • Perform contract and control reviews, continuous monitoring, and risk reporting
  • Manage vendor security questionnaires and ongoing compliance verification

Security Management & Monitoring (SMM) Administration

  • Administer SMM platform documentation, audit activities, and training programs
  • Serve as application owner liaison or support PMO coordination for SMM-related activities
  • Support application ID administration and controls

Physical Security & Access Control

  • Generate and audit Lenel access control reports on a weekly and monthly basis
  • Conduct group audits and access reviews.
  • Support training and onboarding activities

Program & Administrative Support

  • Leverage SharePoint and PowerApps knowledge to streamline workflows and reporting
  • Participate and support change control boards; evaluate applications; participate in technical solutioning and evaluation
  • Support program operations which may include and is not limited to; leading small projects and initiatives, supporting business capture and growth, and providing cross functional support
  • Telework available from EST, MST or CST.time zones.

Qualifications

  • 2 years with BS/BA or 6 years with a HS diploma/equivalent
  • Security Administration experience and the ability to work flexible hours.
  • Experience in security governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), third-party risk management, audit support, and data protection.
  • Experience performing control assessment and gap analysis against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, and managing the POA&M lifecycle
  • Vendor and Application security risk management experience.
  • Authoring ability for policies, control narratives, and deficiency documentation that withstands external review.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration abilities.
  • US. citizenship required.

Desired qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering
  • Healthcare Compliance: Working knowledge of HIPAA/HITECH.
  • CMS: Experience with CMS requirements and Authority to Connect/Operate support, including Security Assessment Workbooks (SAWs), security assessment reports, and control evidence packages
  • State & Federal Government: Experience in government regulated compliance environments
  • Technical Skills: Experience with SharePoint administration, and PowerApps development
  • Incident Response: Hands-on incident response experience in regulated environments
  • Verified Experience: Preference for candidates with verified work experience over recent college graduates
  • Emerging technologies: Artificial intelligence (AI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Large Language Models (LLM)

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Business Operations ManagerRemote (India) | Full-timeAlso searched as: Operations Manager, Business Operations Lead, PMO Manager, Project Operations Manager, Shared Services Manager, GCC Operations Manager.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Business Operations Manager
Remote (India) | Full-time
Also searched as: Operations Manager, Business Operations Lead, PMO Manager, Project Operations Manager, Shared Services Manager, GCC Operations Manager.
Could you lead ops coordinators, project managers and service teams while carrying real projects alongside them?
On a typical day you might run the planning call for a cross-team project you are leading, review a dashboard showing which requests are running late, sit with a pod lead to rebuild an estimate that looks twice as long as the last similar job, and agree with the Internal Product team which manual handoff to automate next.
About Contour

We operate across three brands. The India team, part of the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building. It runs delivery, automation, people and operations for the whole organisation, working closely with teams in Australia.
The kind of people who thrive here
Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on. Today we are about 600 people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing.
The work matters. More than 10,000 students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. People who do well here care about that.
They own their work end to end, start things without being asked and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, write decisions down and give direct feedback. The pace is fast: small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle. Growth follows what you deliver: scope, title and pay move with the bar you raise.
About this role
You lead Operations in Contour's India team: several teams brought together under one player-coach. Your team includes Contour’s operations coordinators, who keep academics, campus, finance and the founder’s office running day to day, and its project coordinators and managers, who run cross-team work across the business. It also covers organisation services such as print operations, procurement and workspace systems.
Each service has two sides. In Australia, a functional owner, such as Finance or Academics, sets its standards and priorities. In India, you run the work: coordinators and project managers report to you directly, and any service big enough for its own pod lead reports through them. Everything else is yours: how work comes in, how it is planned, checked and automated, and how the people doing it grow.
Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you learn each service's workflow well enough to coach its lead, inspect what it produces and challenge its estimates, and you know where your knowledge stops: on professional questions, you rely on the specialists. Second, you make different services run as one, with a shared way of taking requests, planning capacity and checking work, so the rest of Contour deals with one group rather than a row of separate desks.
This is a player-coach seat, and we mean it. Expect a real share of most weeks to go on doing the work yourself: running a cross-team project end to end, taking the coordination nobody else can untangle, checking a sample of finished work, mapping a process that keeps stalling or rebuilding an estimate from the ground up. The rest goes on making your coordinators, project managers and pod leads better at the same work. You won't be the specialist in every service, but you can work inside each one's workflow, and your team sees you do it. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: the scope of this seat grows with the platform, and what you deliver decides how fast. The intake, planning, quality and automation routines you set now are what every later service joins.

What you will do

  • Run work yourself:lead some cross-team projects and coordination directly, especially the messy ones, so you know first-hand what your team is up against.
  • Lead the coordinators and project managers:set how projects and department requests are scoped, tracked and closed, review their plans and status updates, and step in when work slips.
  • Map every service's workflow with the people who run it and document it in Notionso anyone can follow it.
  • Run one front door for requests:a single intake form with clear turnaround times, so the rest of Contour deals with one group.
  • Plan capacity weeklyusing live dashboards of demand, turnaround and backlog, not gut feel.
  • Automate the repeatable:spot manual handoffs, data entry and status chasing, and work with the Internal Product team to automate them (for example with Monday, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace or no-code tools).
  • Use AI where it saves time:first-pass quality checks, drafting SOPs, summarising requests, with people keeping the final call.
  • Inspect quality:review samples of finished work against each owner's standard and fix repeat faults at the source.
  • Challenge estimatesagainst past jobs before they reach the business, and agree any change with whoever owns the work.
  • Keep functional owners informedon demand, risk and capacity, and turn their priorities into your team's plan.
  • Coach directly:structured 1:1s and performance conversations with your reports. Help any pod leads do the same, and make sure everyone knows who relies on their work.
  • Grow the group:build the case when a service needs a hire, a tool or a better process. Hiring goes ahead once the owner confirms approved headcount and budget. Bring a new service into the group only when it fits the pooled model.

Requirements

What you need
We weigh what you have built and run more than years on a CV. You should be able to point to:
  • Teams from more than one discipline that you led and answered for, including one outside your own field.
  • Projects you ran end to end while leading a team.
  • Aworkflow you mapped and rebuilt with the people who run it, which they still use.
  • A manual process you automated or moved onto a tool, with time saved or errors cut.
  • A dashboard or report you built that people used to make decisions.
  • An estimate or plan you pushed back on with evidence, and what changed.
  • People you managed directly, including coordinators or project managers and leads of their own teams.
Comfortable with workflow tools (Monday, Notion, Jira or similar), spreadsheets and dashboards, and curious about AI and no-code tools. You don't need to be an engineer.
If you have delivered these, or can show us how you would here, apply. If you enjoy hands-on work, this seat will suit you; if your recent years have mostly been signing off other people's work, it may feel small.
Nice to have
  • Shared services, a GCC or a team serving colleagues in another country.
  • Education or a student-facing business.
  • Hands-on time with automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n or Apps Script) or process methods such as Lean.
What good looks like after 6 months
  • One front door:anyone at Contour knows how to ask for work and when they will hear back.
  • Dates that hold:the dates your teams give are the dates work lands.
  • Projects that land:cross-team projects run by your group finish on the dates and scope agreed.
  • Less manual work:the top repeat handoffs in your group are automated or removed.
  • Leads who decide:your coordinators and pod leads make daily calls without waiting for you.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India, working across the India and Australia time difference. Pay is benchmarked to the role and discussed openly early in the process.
​
Ready to lead from the front: run the work, coach the people and automate what slows them down? Apply.

Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Iceland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Iceland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

The primary objective is to generate qualified business leads, initiate conversations with potential clients, qualify opportunities, and arrange meetings between prospective customers and our senior sales/business leadership team to explore potential AI and Data project opportunities.

The role will be performed remotely from an offshore location, requiring strong communication skills, confidence in engaging senior stakeholders, and the ability to build a consistent sales pipeline in the Singapore market.

We are looking for someone who is confident, persistent, and commercially driven, with the ability to pick up the phone, approach senior executives, open business conversations, and create opportunities from scratch.

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) generates and conducts consultative discovery calls with investors, business owners, and C-level executives across multiple industries and schedules sales-qualified leads with our Sales Team. These will be leads who have opted in through at least one of our marketing assets.

The SDR will prospect, nurture, and manage pipeline deals, attend meetings, communicate internally, and update the CRM.

The SDR will also be held accountable for monthly booked meetings, held meetings, closed-won meetings, and other key activities that lead to revenue.

Responsibilities

  • Prospect for sales-qualified leads (SQLs) in the CRM task lists and views provided using the SDR outreach cadence. Prioritize the highest-value leads based on engagement recency and engagement volume.
  • Manage inbound meetings by communicating with leads who have scheduled an inbound discovery call to establish trust, connection, and authority before the meeting.
  • Field inbound SMS and emails.
  • Establish high status and leadership from the beginning of each triage conversation.
  • Uncover the prospect’s current situation and desired situation while qualifying the prospect. A qualified prospect has a problem we can help solve, wants help solving the problem now, and has the time and financial resources available to leverage our solution.
  • Set expectations with the prospect regarding why, how, where, and when they should show up to the business consultation in a way that builds the credibility of our company and the Account Executive.
  • Send an ‘Immediate Confirmation’ containing an educational resource and a relevant case study for the prospect to consume prior to the business consultation.
  • Send a ‘3-Way (you, the prospect, and the Account Executive) Confirmation’ such that the prospect’s relationship with the AE is developed prior to the business consultation (you, the prospect, and the Account Executive).
  • Send a ‘Day Before Confirmation’ to the prospect. If the prospect does not confirm before the sales team meeting the following morning, send a ‘Morning Of Confirmation.'
  • Communicate with the Account Executive and nurture the prospect by following up every 3-7 days after the initial meeting. This will maximize the odds of closing the sale until the prospect is closed lost or closed won.
  • Submit an EOD report at the end of each workday
  • Submit KPIs EOD at the end of each workday
  • Log and update each meeting booked in the SDR CRM at the end of each workday
  • Submit a synopsis for each meeting booked
  • Log notes for every triage conversation held in the CRM
  • Attend x1/week 30-minute 1-1 with the Sales Development Manager
  • Attend x5/week 30-minute Sales Department Meetings
  • Attend x1-3/week 60-minute Sales Development Training Sessions

  • Can quickly find common ground and solve problems; can represent his/her own interests and yet be fair to other groups; can solve problems with peers with a minimum of conflict; is seen as a team player and is cooperative; quickly gains trust and support of peers; encourages collaboration.
  • Accurately sets objectives and goals; breaks down work into process steps; develops schedules; anticipates and adjusts for problems and roadblocks; measures performance against goals and evaluates results.
  • Must be an effective communicator in a variety of settings: one-on one, small and large groups, with peers and direct reports.

About the Opportunity


JOB SUMMARY

Northeastern University’s Research Enterprise Services (NU-RES) provides leadership and expertise to faculty, investigators and college administrators in support of research and sponsored programs at Northeastern University. NU -- a dynamic, innovative, and entrepreneurial university with a diverse and growing research portfolio -- seeks to hire talented, experienced administrators who are dedicated to supporting investigators secure and manage their extramurally sponsored activities. The University is committed to hiring and developing personnel who enjoy working in a high-performing culture that rewards excellence. As a key member of the NU-RES Contracts Team plays a critical role in supporting, facilitating and advancing faculty research and sponsored activities across NU’s Global University System, including NU’s wholly-owned subsidiary KRI at Northeastern University, LLC, by advising faculty and administrators on a wide-range of regulatory and practical issues related to extramurally funded contracts and agreements with industry, Federal agencies, and non-profit organizations. Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Slovakia

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Slovakia. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. This role establishes strong cross-cultural relationships, builds a common language of performance and accountability, and ensures international teams are fully enabled to deliver across all operational functions (claims, enrollment, provider, billing, customer service, grievance & appeals, etc.).

This individual contributor role operates at the enterprise level, partnering with leaders across operations to align expectations, remove barriers, and leverage the unique strengths of international teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cultural & Communication Integration
    • Build a “common language” across onshore and offshore teams to reduce misunderstandings and ensure shared expectations.
    • Act as a bridge for translating business requirements into clear, actionable steps for offshore execution.
    • Facilitate transparent, regular communication between global teams and domestic leadership.
  • Operational Readiness
    • Ensure offshore teams have equal access to training, documentation, and support as onshore teams.
    • Identify and resolve barriers (system access, time zone alignment, performance processes) that limit offshore effectiveness.

    • Highlight offshore innovations (process improvements, accuracy models) that can be adopted more broadly.
    • Ensure consistency in performance management across onshore and offshore staff (no “two-tiered” standards).
  • Change Leadership
    • Champion the shift from a client-based model to a shared-services model, ensuring international resources are prepared for scale.
    • Actively foster a “one team” culture across geographies, minimizing divides and maximizing collaboration.

This role is not simply about oversight, it is about creating the conditions for global teams to succeed at scale. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Customer Support Specialist (AU Shift)
Remote (India) | Full-time | Voice and text support: calls, email and live chat
Also searched as: Senior Customer Support Specialist (AU Process), Support Team Lead, Customer Experience Team Lead, Student Support Lead, Customer Support Automation Specialist, AU Process, International Voice Process (Australia), Customer Support Executive (AU shift)
Could you be the best person on a support team, on the phone and in writing, make everyone around you better, and build the automations that take the repetitive work off their plate?
On a typical day you might clear the night's escalations before the shift settles in, sit with a new agent to rewrite a reply to an upset parent, test an AI agent that drafts first replies to the ten most common questions, and walk the Melbourne team through unresolved cases at handover.
About Contour
We operate across three brands. The India team, which falls under the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building: it runs delivery, automation, people, and operations for the whole organisation.
The Kind of People Who Thrive Here
Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on. Today we are [about 600] people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing.
The work matters. More than [10,000] students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. The people who do well here care about that and want to know their work made a difference to those students.
They own their work end to end, start things without being asked, and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, including when something is off and what they have already tried, and write decisions down so the next person can pick them up. They give direct feedback and ask for it back.
The pace is fast. Small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle, and whoever spots the problem usually gets to lead the fix. We keep refining how we work, and you are expected to improve the processes you own.
We hire on what you have built and run yourself, and growth works the same way. Time with us counts, but scope, title and pay move with what you deliver and how much you raise the bar on what you own.
The GCC is being built now, seat by seat. This one decides how fast and how well a family gets an answer when they write or call Contour.
About This Role
You lead the Support team that students and parents reach when they write to Contour by email or live chat, and soon by phone. You report to the Customer Support Manager. This is a voice and text role: written support today, and calls as the phone line opens in stages, so you need to be as strong on a call as you are in an email.
This is a lead who still works the queue. You take the hardest cases yourself, and you spend the rest of your time making the team faster and better: training, reviewing replies, coaching on the spot, and building the macros, workflows and AI tools that answer the simple questions so people can focus on the hard ones. Payment cases go to the Payments coordinator, refund policy stays with Finance, and academic decisions stay with the Academics team. Everything about how the Support team answers is yours.
Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you raise the team, not just your own numbers: a week after you coach someone, their replies read differently. Second, you are tech-forward: when you see the same question fifty times, your first thought is how to automate the answer, not how to type it faster.
Communication is a requirement for this role, not a preference. You will speak with parents and students in Australia every day, and coach agents who do the same. That calls for excellent spoken and written English, a confident and composed manner on the phone, and strong comprehension of Australian and other international accents at natural speed, along with comfort with how Australians talk: first names, casual phrasing, directness, and knowing when to slow down. We are not looking for an Australian accent; we are looking for English an Australian parent understands on the first listen. Your spoken English is assessed through a standard English test and a live call early in the process.
We want a player-coach who leads by example, not someone who only directs. You will be on the queue every day, more in busy weeks, and on the phones from the first day they open. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: as the phones go live, automation takes on more of the queue and the team grows, the scope of this seat grows with it.
A reply that arrives late, or says something different from the last one, leaves a family unsure whether Contour has their child's back.

Where the Work Lives

  • HubSpot:the inboxes, tickets and records, where each conversation is logged so the next person, in India or Australia, sees it.
  • The phone system:being set up now and connected to HubSpot, so calls, recordings and callbacks sit on the family's record.
  • Automation and AI:HubSpot workflows, chatbots, AI agents such as OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot), and no-code tools such as Zapier, Make or n8n, which you help set up and improve.
What You Will Do
  • Run the shift:Keep the inbox and chat moving, take the escalations and the cases nobody wants, and keep response times inside the agreed limits.
  • Train and coach:Onboard new agents, shadow them, review their replies and calls every week, and give feedback they can use the same day.
  • Hold the quality bar:Score a sample of replies and calls against the standard, find the repeat mistakes and fix them at the source, whether that is a person, a macro or a missing article.
  • Build the knowledge base:Write and keep current the macros, SOPs and help-centre pages, so a new agent gives the same answer you would.
  • Automate the support pipeline:Set up ticket routing, tagging, auto-replies and HubSpot workflows; test chatbots and AI agents that draft, summarise or answer common questions; and keep a person on every case the bot can't solve.
  • Measure what automation does:Track how many questions the bot answers correctly, where it gets things wrong, and what it saves the team each week.
  • Help open the phones:Take calls from the first stage, build call guides with the Manager, and coach agents through their first live calls.
  • Hand over cleanly:Pass payment cases to the Payments coordinator and academic questions to Academics with the record complete, and end each shift with notes Australia can act on without asking.
  • Keep the numbers honest:Share a daily snapshot of the queue, response times and quality per agent, so problems show up before they become complaints.
If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.

Requirements

What You Need
We weigh what you have built and run more than the years on your CV. We expect 2–4 years in customer support as your main line of work, not a stop on the way to something else. You should be able to point to:
  • Hundreds of customer cases you handled yourself on email, chat or phone, including angry or emotional ones.
  • Agents you trained or coached, and how their quality or speed changed afterwards.
  • A macro, SOP, help article or quality checklist you wrote that the team still uses.
  • An automation you set up yourself: a ticket workflow, a chatbot, an AI agent or a no-code pipeline that took manual work off the team, with what it saved.
  • A ticketing toolyou know well (HubSpot, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom or similar), including the views, rules and workflows behind it.
  • A shift or queue you kept covered when the lead or manager was away.
  • Excellent spoken and written English (essential): clear, confident and easy for an Australian parent to follow on the first listen, with strong comprehension of Australian, UK and other international accents at natural speed, and the composure to stay calm and in control on a difficult call.
  • Australian cultural fluency: comfort with casual Aussie phrasing, first-name rapport and directness, and knowing when to slow down for a worried parent.
  • Experience on an Australian process (voice, chat or email) is a strong advantage; UK or New Zealand processes count too.
If you have delivered these, or can show us how you would here, apply. If you enjoy solving customer problems yourself and building the tools that solve them faster, this seat will suit you; if you mainly want to manage people who do, it may feel small.
Nice to Have
  • Hands-on time with AI agents or LLM tools (OpenClaw, ChatGPT, Claude or similar) for support, beyond using them as a chat window.
  • EdTech or education background.
  • IELTS, PTE or Cambridge C1 Advanced: helpful, not required.
  • Phone support alongsidechat and email.
What Good Looks Like
  • A team that answers like you:quality scores rise across the team, not just for a few agents.
  • Times inside the limits:first-response and resolution times hold every week, including busy ones.
  • Automation that earns its place:the most common questions are answered or drafted automatically, correctly, and the team spends its time on the cases that need a person.
  • Phones live:agents take calls confidently, and every call sits on the family's record in HubSpot.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India, and comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference. Shifts follow Australian business hours [to confirm]: 9am to 5pm Melbourne time is 3:30am to 11:30am IST during Australian daylight saving (October to April), and 4:30am to 12:30pm IST the rest of the year. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience; we discuss it openly early in the process.
​
Ready to lead a support team from the queue, and automate the work that slows it down? Apply.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Embedded
jobs.excerpt: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.
jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

jobs.description:
Role Title: French Language Expert (France)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: France, Remote

micro1 is engaging French Language Experts (France) to contribute to a customer’s audio annotation project focused on French as spoken in France. In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. This engagement is ideal for those with extensive experience in language-related fields such as teaching, transcription, editing, translation, or journalism, or any background that demonstrates a deep familiarity with the nuances of French as spoken in France.

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to and analyze multi-speaker conversational audio samples featuring a range of French dialects and accents from France.
  2. Tag audio and speaker metadata, including aspects such as audio quality, background noise, dialect, accent, age, and speaking style.
  3. Edit and correct automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts using French spelling, vocabulary, and conventions as used in France.
  4. Identify and annotate region-specific linguistic features, idioms, slang, and pronunciation patterns such as regional accents and informal speech (e.g., “t’as,” “ouais”).
  5. Ensure all annotations are accurate, consistent, and align with project guidelines emphasizing French distinctions as used in France.
  6. Collaborate with project team members through written and verbal channels to clarify guidelines or resolve linguistic ambiguities.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluent proficiency in French as spoken in France, with a strong command of its regional varieties.
  2. Background in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or related fields.
  3. Demonstrated ability to distinguish between French dialects and accents from France (e.g., Parisian, Southern/Marseillais, Alsatian, Breton, Norman, Lyonnais).
  4. Familiarity with French vocabulary, idioms, slang, and spelling conventions (including verlan, regional expressions, and English influences).
  5. Meticulous attention to detail and a keen ear for subtle linguistic differences.
  6. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity, accuracy, and collaboration.
  7. Experience in audio annotation or ASR transcript editing is an asset, though not required.

jobs.excerpt: About Positron AI Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference.
jobs.description:
About Positron AI

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip-to-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders.

Role Overview

Running one AI model across many chips is a distributed systems problem: a host and many chips exchanging data over links, waiting on each other, and failing in ways no single chip would. As a Senior Distributed Systems Engineer, you will help us simulate that system before the hardware exists. You will work with the chip modeling, SDK, and runtime teams to build the simulators that stand in for the host, the links, and the protocols between chips.

This role is about building and scaling simulation infrastructure, not testing someone else's code. You will own the software architecture of the multi-chip simulation stack, decide how much fidelity each layer needs, and keep it fast enough that distributed software is exercised every day in CI.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Chip Simulator Design

  • Design and build the simulators for the host-to-chip and chip-to-chip layers of our system, including the drivers, links, protocols, and transfers that connect many chips into one machine.
  • Model the communication fabric, including transfer timing, collectives, ordering guarantees, back-pressure, congestion, and partial failure, calibrated against real hardware.

Architecture and Scale

  • Own the architecture of the multi-chip simulation stack as new chips, interconnects, and deployment topologies arrive.
  • Compose simulators of different fidelity (fast functional, cycle-level, and hardware emulation) into one coherent multi-chip simulation.
  • Scale the simulation from a few chips to full racks while keeping runs fast enough for daily use in CI.

Correlation and Quality

  • Correlate simulated behavior against emulation and hardware measurements, with regression coverage and clear documentation of assumptions and limitations.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a distributed systems engineer building and operating software that coordinates many machines or accelerators through RPC, message passing, consensus, or collective communication.
  • A strong understanding of the failure modes of distributed software, including races, partial failure, ordering and consistency, timeouts and retries, back-pressure, and deadlock.
  • Demonstrated experience debugging timing-dependent bugs across hosts, NICs, or accelerators using traces and logs.
  • Experience building simulators, emulators, or test harnesses for distributed or networked systems is strongly preferred.
  • Sound judgment in choosing the right level of fidelity for a question and balancing accuracy against run time.
  • Strong Rust skills, or expert-level C/C++ skills and a willingness to work in Rust day to day, along with proficiency in Python for tooling and analysis.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain what the simulation shows, what it does not, and what the software or hardware team should change.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with multi-GPU or multi-accelerator inference or training, including NCCL-style collectives, tensor, pipeline, and expert parallelism, and host-device runtimes.
  • Familiarity with hardware emulators such as Cadence Palladium or Synopsys ZeBu, or with FPGA prototyping.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

Why Join Us?

  • You will own the architecture of the simulation stack that lets our distributed software run across racks of chips long before the hardware exists.
  • You will work across chip modeling, SDK, and runtime teams on one of the hardest problems in AI inference: making many chips behave as one machine.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is Mid: $160,000-$220,000, Senior: $220,000–$270,000, Principal: $270,000-$350,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Benefits & Perks

We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.

Health and wellness

  • Fully company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Company-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more
  • Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available

Time off and flexibility

  • Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge
  • 13 paid company holidays
  • Remote-first culture with a company-provided computer and home office setup

Compensation and future

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one

Visa Support

This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates.

Great experiences start with a great MIND.

We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager to own the event and partner programs that builds pipeline in your region. This is not an admin or logistics role. Why MIND?

At MIND, we’re reimagining data loss prevention (DLP) for the AI era. Our vision is simple: make data security simple, autonomous and complete to become Stress Free. We’re building a new approach to an old problem, and we need a storyteller who can help bring that vision to life.

We’re not interested in doing things simply because that’s how they’ve always been done.

At MIND, we’re challenging the status quo in data security, building technology that helps organizations mind what matters most without the complexity of traditional DLP.

We’re also building a team of people who care about the work, support one another and aren’t afraid to think differently.

Our values guide how we work:

  • Mind What Matters. Focus on the work that creates meaningful impact.
  • Act With Empathy. Lead with understanding and treat people with care.
  • Win Together. Great ideas and great results come from collaboration.
  • Improve Every Day. Stay curious, keep learning and never stop getting better.

Bring your ideas, your creativity and your personality. Come be a MINDer and MIND What Matters.

Responsibility

What you'll do

Partner with sales as a strategic advisor

  • Act as the go-to marketing consultant for regional sales leaders and reps, aligning programs to their territory plans, target accounts and pipeline goals
  • Recommend which events, partners and formats to invest in, and which to pass on, with a clear rationale
  • Plan ahead with a rolling quarterly event calendar so sales has time to invite and prepare

Build and run partner and event programs

  • Co-plan and execute joint programs with channel partners including GuidePoint, Softchoice and boutique resellers
  • Evaluate, negotiate and manage trade show and third-party event sponsorships

Drive registration and follow-up

Work across the company

  • Collaborate with sales, product marketing, product, engineering and the broader marketing team on content, demos, speakers and messaging

Requirements

What you bring

  • 5+ years in field, event or partner marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity
  • A track record of running partner and channel programs with VARs or resellers (GuidePoint, Softchoice or similar is a plus)
  • Hands-on experience planning trade shows, executive events and bespoke experiences, and managing outside vendors
