jobs.excerpt: As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP).
jobs.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.
Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.
We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

This is a foundational engineering role. You will own a critical domain of the platform on which Agiloft's CLM product is built as one of a small team of staff engineers who each own a core part of the platform and shape its direction together. This is a backend- and distributed-systems–weighted position with deep ownership of your domain and end-to-end accountability for its design, scalability, reliability, and security as the product and customer base grow.

You will work across the organization with engineering leaders, senior engineers, product leaders, and partner teams to understand where the product is going, translate business and product goals into durable platform architectures, and align diverse stakeholders on the technical direction. This means, you will set architectural direction alongside a peer group of staff engineers of your caliber. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep backend and cloud expertise with the influence to drive architecture across functional boundaries.

Job Responsibilities

    DATA MODEL & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE

  • Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain
  • Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations
  • Evolve the platform through additive, backward-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior.
  • Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term technical health.

    • DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)

  • Design AWS-native, event-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost-efficient as volume grows.
  • Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.
  • Drive cloud-native design principles: stateless services, managed-service adoption, and failure-tolerant, self-healing architectures.

    • SECURITY & MULTI-TENANCY

  • Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first-class design concerns across every service and API you own.
  • Design secure authentication and token-handling flows, permission-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform.
  • Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities.

    • TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE

  • Partner with product- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem
  • Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge.
  • Integrate diverse stakeholders and project teams around a shared technical direction, navigating differing functional interests with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skill.
  • Produce clear, rigorous design documents, service contracts, and acceptance criteria that others can review, build on, and trust, setting the standard for technical design on the team.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate and sharpen design and implementation, applying the judgment to know where they add leverage and where deeper thinking is required.
  • Lead by example in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate architecture, design, implementation, and testing, using sound technical judgment to amplify productivity without compromising quality, maintainability, or depth of thinking.

    • API DESIGN

  • Design clean, versioned API contracts on top of the platform's data models — including high-scale bulk and asynchronous operations — with deterministic behavior, idempotency, structured error handling, and well-defined limits.
  • Establish contract tests and permission-enforcement validation as first-class parts of every API you design.

    • DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

  • Own initiatives end to end from design through release, with accountability for product quality in your domain and high standards for reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability, usability, and cost across the services you own
  • Champion modern practices: infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, continuous delivery, and observability-by-default
  • Lead platform-modernization and refactoring initiatives while maintaining delivery velocity and improve the developer experience for the services you own.
  • Identify and drive improvements to how the engineering organization designs and delivers
  • Contribute across the stack when an initiative calls for it, including UI layers on top of the platform services you build; backend remains the primary focus.

    • ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT & MENTORSHIP

  • Serve as a technical multiplier unblocking teams, accelerating architectural decisions, and reducing long-term complexity.
  • Partner with CloudOps, Security, MLOps, and integration teams to define reliability targets, operational-readiness standards, and clean interfaces between domains.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raising the bar for data-model and systems design, security, and design-document quality.
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving industry, particularly the rapid evolution of AI capabilities, and drive pragmatic adoption where it delivers clear business value.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's and/or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software or Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years at staff level.
  • Demonstrated leadership of architecture decisions spanning multiple teams with concrete examples of driving cross-team technical direction to a decision.
  • Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across diverse stakeholders and teams that report into different functions, aligning divergent interests without direct authority.
  • Track record of owning significant initiatives end to end, including release ownership.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (working experience in Java a plus), building backend and cloud-based services.
  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating scalable, enterprise-grade distributed systems on AWS.
  • Strong data-modeling and service-architecture skills, with a track record of building durable, reusable abstractions that other teams adopt and extend without rework.
  • Experience designing backend systems that enable demanding workloads wih high-throughput data pipelines, asynchronous processing, or ML/inference services at scale and with cost-efficiently.
  • Solid grounding in application security and multi-tenancy: authentication/authorization, token handling, tenant isolation, and permission-aware data access.
  • Experience designing high-scale API contracts
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD for cloud services.
  • Strong understanding of observability in distributed systems: logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • A demonstrated habit of staying current with rapidly evolving AI capabilities and integrating them into how you work and design.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English

Preferred Qualifications

    Additional Experience (a plus)

  • Building services that support AI/ML product features and data pipelines
  • Integrating third-party SaaS platforms and connectors with attention to security and reliability.
  • Search and retrieval systems
  • Domain familiarity with CLM, contracts, or comparable enterprise B2B platforms.

Background checks will be conducted on an ongoing basis every 3 years or as needed for individuals in this role.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Life Sciences Meetings Management (Europe/US - Remote)
jobs.excerpt: Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need youSpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars.
locationRestrictions: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
jobs.description:
Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: the Live HCP Engagement Platform that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn live events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

Pharma companies use event platforms as registration forms while request, approval, budget, HCP registration, transfer of value (ToV), and reporting run in Excel and at agencies. We are building Onomi 360, the life-sciences strategic meetings management (SMM) product, to replace the incumbent event platform in that space. First accounts already run their meeting requests and approvals in Onomi 360; the demand is validated and the trajectory is exciting.

Your focus will be MeetingsEQ, the SMM layer of Onomi 360: one front door for every request, approval and budget as configuration, unified HCP identity, per-attendee ToV allocation, and engagement and spend flowing back into the CRM without re-keying. The customer's CRM and master data stay where they are; the event platform behind the meetings program is where we play. AI-assisted development is how we work, and you will have real freedom to use it.

This position is the ideal role for a hands-on product leader from the life-sciences meetings, compliance, or HCP-data world who would rather ship and test than talk about the problem, and who wants to own one product end to end and see the process they once operated replaced with a modern, AI-first workflow.

As a Senior Product Manager, Onomi 360, you will be reporting to the VP Product. Your time will be spent on:

  • [35%] Defining the detailed product. Turn customer workbooks, operating procedures, RFP requirements, and our capability map into roadmap priorities and build-ready specifications.
  • [30%] Shipping. Work daily with design and engineering in the Onomi 360 codebase: thin production slices, prototypes, scope calls, validation in the running product. Daily AI-based prototyping and customer validation.
  • [25%] Customers and partners. Work with meetings operations, compliance, medical affairs, finance, agencies, and the customer’s data team. Define how Onomi 360 works with Veeva, Salesforce, Snowflake, and consent, and own the venue-sourcing and fair-market-value partner integrations.
  • [10%] Product truth. Keep what we claim, what we demo, and what we ship documented, clear and moving in the right direction.

Objectives - The problems you will solve

In your first month, you will:

  • Take over the first customer’s move from their meeting request form to Onomi 360: spec, build, history migration, customer session.
  • Get set up with AI-based toolkit and the Onomi 360 codebase, and use both in your daily work.
  • Meet the early access customers (design partners) for Onomi 360.

After 3 months, you will have:

  • The first customer live on meeting request and approvals in Onomi 360, measured against their baseline.
  • The roadmap priorities for the next two quarters defined, and the first priorities specified to build depth with engineering.
  • A clean separation everyone uses: aspirational (slides), forward-looking (prototype-based demo), and committed (roadmap and backlog).

After 6 months, you will have:

  • The full end-to-end MeetingsEQ product specified and engineering-reviewed, request through approval, budget, HCP registration, ToV, and reporting.
  • One customer replacing Excel with the Onomi 360 ToV module, and the first live account expanded from request and approval into budget, ToV, or venue sourcing.

After 12 months, you will have:

  • One customer closing a full ToV reporting cycle in Onomi 360 instead of Excel.
  • Three accounts running request to closure in production, and the org-wide calendar or HCP engagement view used outside compliance.
  • Onomi 360 winning the meetings-management scope in RFPs.

What you need to be great at

  • Life-sciences meetings, compliance, or transparency operations. You have built or operated workflows spanning approval, budgeting, ToV, and closure, and you know what EFPIA and Sunshine disclosure mean in practice.
  • HCP data and integration fluency. Identity across Veeva, Salesforce, OneKey, and NPI; match rates; what a data team expects from a write-back.
  • Domain-to-product translation. A messy operating process becomes states, rules, configuration, permissions, and audit events, with regulation separated from customer policy.
  • Sequencing. The smallest production slice that proves the model without hiding the hard architectural or compliance question.
  • Bias to execute. You ship, prototype, and put things in front of users in days, not spend weeks describing the problem. You drive decisions to a close and pull others along.
  • Precise writing and direct communication. Specs detailed enough to build and review, plain words, disagreement in the open.
  • Technical and AI fluency. You work in Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, you understand code, data flows, and architecture well enough to challenge an engineering design. You know the software development lifecycle deeply, from RFC and specification through review, release, and support. AI takes you from evidence to a testable artifact in hours.

What we want to hear about

jobs.description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.
Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.
We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.
Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.
This role calls for a strong hunter mindset and passion for working in a hyper-growth MarTech scale-up with a rapid sales cycle. Good news: our differentiated product is already in high demand! We’ve got clients from every vertical imaginable, and our client base speaks for itself. So, you will be lucky to have a category leader product, fuelled by lightning-fast growth and our all-star engineers, and just as our co-founder/CRO promises, “If you stay humble and hungry, you’ll build a legacy here.”
If you are interested in further developing your sales career in SaaS, get ready to engage with enterprise-level clients across various industries such as retail, finance, automotive, telecom, and travel through our product of client choice. (Actually, let’s make our clients do the talking — you can check their testimonials on our website!)

What You Will Do

  • You will handle overall responsibility for managing sales, achieving growth, and hitting/exceeding annual sales targets.
  • You will interact with clients at all the stages of the sales cycle, from prospecting and acquiring clients through demoing the platform to negotiating and closing.
  • You will provide on-the-ground support/mentorship for the Sales Development Representative (SDR) team to generate new qualified opportunities and pipelines through innovative outbound strategies.
  • We create value by sharing thoughtful insights for our partners and potential partners. You will effectively communicate the value proposition through proposals and presentations. You also need to ensure that they get the most out of the deals we offer, such as free trials.
  • You will be the guru of your own market and provide insight to the team on market trends, unmet needs, and opportunities to deliver greater value to clients by extending company offerings. You will identify emerging markets and market shifts while being fully aware of new products and competition status.
  • You will develop and implement new sales initiatives, strategies, and programs to capture key demographics.
  • You will present sales, revenue, and realistic forecasts to the management team.
  • You will get supported by Marketing, Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, and Sales Enablement functions.
  • To have consistent success, you will do accurate forecasting and maintain an up-to-date pipeline at all times. We believe sales is a balancing act!

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related fields.
  • Minimum 4 years of quota-carrying sales experience, preferably in SaaS or MarTech.
  • Knowledge of market research, sales, and negotiating principles.
  • Proven verbal and written communication abilities, effective phone skills, and exquisite listening skills.
  • Our technical knowledge goes well beyond that of any other salesperson. You need to be a savvy tech bug, always searching for solutions and ideas.
  • Ability to succeed working cross-functionally with direct sales, marketing, and customer success teams.
  • Superior project and time management skills.
  • The ability and flexibility to work in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Previous experience with retail, finance, automotive, telecom, and travel industries is a big plus!

What We Offer

  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.

  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.
  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.
We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.
To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.
If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.
We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

jobs.description:
Working at memoryBlue will accelerate your professional growth and place you on the path to success early in your sales career. Whether you’re aiming to jump-start a high-tech sales career in Silicon Valley or help us haul in the next crop of talented sales development professionals in our DC Metro Headquarters, we have immediate job openings in all of our offices from coast-to-coast.

Want to take your sales career to the next level? Look no further than memoryBlue, the fastest-growing sales development company in B2B tech.

With clear pathways to help you climb the ladder and plenty of opportunities for growth, we offer careers, not just jobs. In fact, we promoted 50 team members in just an 18-month timeframe.

Who are we?

At memoryBlue, we’re more than just a sales development consultancy – we’re a launching pad for high-tech sales careers. Founded in 2002, we specialize in helping high-growth B2B technology companies accelerate pipeline and revenue through outsourced sales development. With offices across North America and Europe, and a global team of 300+ professionals, we support innovative startups and global tech giants alike.

Our mission is twofold:

  • Deliver exceptional results for our clients by generating qualified sales leads and driving outbound prospecting campaigns.
  • Develop top-tier sales talent, giving our team members the tools, training, and mentorship they need to build long-term careers in tech sales.

We’ve proudly supported some of the world’s most respected tech brands and continue to cultivate a community that values curiosity, grit, and growth. Whether you're looking to grow your sales career or scale your sales pipeline, memoryBlue is the partner that delivers.

What are the responsibilities of a Sales Development Representative?

Our Sales Development Team is responsible for generating new business and growing existing accounts via outbound sales activities. This is an essential part of the sales process and involves identifying potential clients and initiating contact via various channels, including phone calls, email campaigns and social media platforms. As well as outbound sales, there is a key element of account management and relationship building with clients.

For this particular role, you will be responsible for engaging with businesses and prospects across the Australian and/or New Zealand markets. Previous professional experience selling into or working with these markets is therefore essential.

The core responsibilities of this role are:

  • Place between 50–70 outbound calls to set appointments and initiate the sales process on behalf of our clients.
  • Account management, developing and maintaining strong relationships with clients.
  • Work to achieve daily, weekly and monthly goals through the execution of lead generation activities.

  • As well as receiving financial bonuses as you climb our internal career ladder, we have many other incentives to reward you for your work.
  • The beloved running club – be in with a chance to win prizes as you compete with other runners!

WHAT WE LOOK FOR:

  • Previous professional experience working with or selling into the Australian and/or New Zealand market is essential. This could include experience in sales, business development, account management, customer success or another client-facing commercial role where you regularly engaged with customers or prospects in these markets.

  • Strong written, verbal and phone skills.
  • IT proficient.
  • Metrics-driven and goal-orientated.

Please note: This is not a general Singapore based sales position. The successful candidate will specifically support campaigns targeting businesses and prospects in Australia and/or New Zealand, which is why previous professional experience working with these markets is a key requirement for the role.

jobs.description:
Digital Designer

PH location / Remote first

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good. With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role We are looking for a creative and collaborative Digital Designer to join our Digital Product team! In this role, your goal is simple: help us design the digital experiences that turn curious consumers into loyal subscribers.

Working closely with our eCommerce Specialist, Growth Marketing, and Creative partners, you will take our brand campaigns and translate them into engaging on-site experiences. You’ll work closely with our Product Designer on the storefront, with a focus on visual craft, brand expression, and keeping the storefront looking fresh and commercially effective.

We are also excited for this person to embrace AI. You'll use AI tools to speed up your day-to-day workflow—handling routine formatting and generating assets so you have more time to spend on the actual creative craft that AI can't replicate.

If you worked here this past month, here are some things you might have been involved in:

  • Helping design a site takeover for a new product launch (like adding a cameo from “Clammy” as a temporary avatar during our Splash Limited Edition).
  • Using AI tools to generate draft assets and format standard banners, saving yourself hours of manual resizing.
  • Collaborating with Growth Marketing to iterate on landing pages, making sure the design connects the ad content smoothly to the shop experience.
  • Partnering with the Product Designer to ensure your campaign placements fit nicely within the everyday storefront.
  • Updating standard campaign placements (banners, hero treatments, product callouts) to keep the site looking unmistakably Who Gives A Crap.
  • Sprinkling digital easter eggs across the site that reward curiosity (like hiding toilets across the site for a "Where's the Loo" Limited Edition campaign).

Let’s talk about you
You are a solid visual designer who understands that great digital design isn't just about looking good—it's about helping the customer find what they need. You have a great eye for typography and composition, and you're eager to learn how your designs impact metrics like conversion.

Here’s what we're hoping you'll bring to the table:

  • Visual Craft: You have a strong portfolio of digital work. You know how to take a campaign brief and apply it to digital surfaces while keeping the brand feeling consistent and high-quality.
  • Curiosity around AI: You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools to speed up your production work, but you know that the final brand finish and quality control always stay with you.
  • Commercial Interest: You want to know why a design works. You're curious about how campaigns perform on site and are open to using customer insights to tweak your designs.
  • A Collaborative Mindset: You are a great team player. You listen well, adapt your communication style depending on who you are working with (marketing, engineering, etc.), and take constructive feedback in stride.
  • Time Management: You know how to juggle multiple tasks. Campaign work moves fast, so you are good at prioritizing your time, keeping the team updated on your progress, and flagging when you need help.

You give a crap
Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?
First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world. We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right). Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?
If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Who are we?

The Motley Fool is a purpose-driven financial services company on a mission to make the world smarter, happier, and richer. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team that values high-quality work, curiosity, and initiative. What does this team do?

The Fool is a place where a lot of fun and a lot of work happen quickly. Our Legal team helps us innovate while adhering to the laws and regulations that may affect all of the work and fun we do. We look to our lawyers to help us avoid fiascos, like [redacted] or [also redacted], but we especially want them to help us create great services for our members and the world.

What would you do in this role?

Comfortable taking on new and unique challenges in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, you will help us deliver trusted, tech-forward products while mitigating regulatory risk This is a high-impact role ideal for a lawyer who thrives at the intersection of innovation and regulation and can quickly assess risk, deliver pragmatic guidance, and enable responsible innovation at a rapid pace.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Growth
jobs.excerpt: Who is Credible? Credible is a leading U. S.  consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products.
jobs.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the CRO (conversion rate optimization) of Credible's performance marketing landing pages and on-site funnel. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of performance marketing, product, and data - responsible for the experiments roadmap, landing page creation and optimization, and the testing infrastructure that helps Credible convert more of its paid traffic into qualified leads.

You will work directly with the Head of Performance Marketing and partner closely with Engineering, Design, and BI to run a continuous stream of CRO experiments. The ideal candidate combines strong product instincts with a quantitative mindset and a bias for shipping tests quickly over building perfect solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the experiments roadmap: maintain and prioritize a rolling backlog of CRO and landing page experiments across all verticals (Personal Loans, Student Loan Refi, Private Student Loans, Insurance, etc.); sequence tests by impact and dependency
  • Landing page creation & optimization using Credible’s CMS: collaborate with Design, Engineering, and Marketing to build and refine landing pages that boost Quality Score, load speed, conversion rates, and overall CMS capabilities
  • A/B test design and analysis: define hypotheses, success metrics, and minimum detectable effects for each experiment; own statistical analysis and present clear readouts with recommended next steps
  • Funnel performance ownership: track and own KPIs across the paid funnel — click-to-prequal rate, prequal-to-submit rate, submit-to-approval rate — and identify the highest-leverage drop-off points
  • Cross-functional execution: coordinate with Engineering on implementation timelines, with BI on instrumentation and event tracking, and with the SEM team on campaign alignment and Quality Score requirements
  • Performance reporting: build and maintain dashboards that give the marketing team real-time visibility into experiment status, landing page performance, and conversion trends
  • Conversion signal infrastructure: partner with the BI Engineer to improve offline conversion data quality and ensure experiment results feed back accurately into Google Ads bidding signals
  • User insight synthesis: use session recordings, heatmaps, funnel analytics, and qualitative feedback to generate testable hypotheses and maintain a prioritized insight backlog

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience: 5+ years in a Product Management role with a strong focus on conversion rate optimization, growth, or performance marketing products
  • CRO depth: hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests on landing pages or on-site funnels; familiarity with statistical significance, sample sizing, and experiment pitfalls
  • Marketing fluency: strong understanding of paid acquisition mechanics - Quality Score, landing page relevance, campaign-to-page alignment, and how conversion rate impacts paid channel economics
  • Technical collaboration: able to write clear specs, work closely with engineers on implementation, and understand front-end constraints without needing to code
  • Data skills: experienced with Google Analytics, Looker, or similar analytics tools
  • Speed and pragmatism: bias for launching imperfect tests quickly over waiting for perfect conditions; comfortable operating in a high-iteration environment
  • Communication: strong written English; able to present experiment results and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Education: Bachelor's degree; quantitative, engineering, or business background preferred

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience at a FinTech, financial marketplace, or lead-generation company
  • Familiarity with Google Ads Quality Score and how landing page experience affects paid channel performance
  • Experience with Strapi
  • Experience with tools like Optimizely, VWO, Google Optimize, or similar experimentation platforms
  • Background working with session replay tools (Hotjar, FullStory) and funnel analytics (Mixpanel, Amplitude)
  • Prior experience in a performance marketing or growth role before moving into PM
  • Experience managing experiments across mobile and desktop simultaneously

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay ranges for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location, are listed below. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents.

View more details about Credible Benefits

For high cost of labor markets such as but not limited to New York City and San Francisco:
$140,000—$165,000 USD
For all other US locations:
$120,000—$150,000 USD

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. jobs.description:
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

About The Role

We're looking for an Agile Coach to enable our Product Engineering squads to work more effectively together across the full product development lifecycle - from problem definition and discovery, through to delivery, release and outcome measurement. You’ll bring consistency and rigour to how individual squads work at every stage, and own the consistency of how those squads plan, visualise progress, and share their work.

We're looking for someone with solid, hands-on coaching experience who's not afraid to roll up their sleeves and get stuck into squad ways of working and drive impact.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Product Designers, Software Engineers, Data Analysts, and leadership across Product Engineering. Rather than spreading thin across every team at once, you'll typically go deep - spending an extended period (for example, a quarter) embedded with one or two squads at a time, building the relationships and trust needed to drive real, measurable change before moving focus elsewhere.

What you'll do

  • Coach squads to embed effective agile and product-centric practices helping teams adopt dual-track ways of working so research and discovery run effectively alongside delivery.

  • Guide teams as they mature their delivery practices and adopt product-centred planning and prioritisation approaches.

  • Coach teams on outcomes over output, helping them understand whether what they shipped actually had the desired customer and business impact.

  • Facilitate team-level meetings (refinement, retrospectives, planning) as required as part of team coaching.

  • Help drive our shift left quality approach.

  • Eliminate blockers through creative conversation and become a trusted advisor to the teams you work with.

  • Offer insight on which metrics best measure team effectiveness and how to improve them over time.

  • Act as a catalyst for change and experimentation, embedding an agile mindset without imposing a one-size-fits-all solution.

  • Coach teams to build and sustain the habit of keeping their roadmaps, delivery plans, and progress clearly visualised spotting where consistency is slipping across squads and working with the relevant people to close the gap.

  • Own the cadence of cross-squad sessions (e.g. show & tells, team learnings) - organising, running, and iterating on them so good practice and information travel beyond a single team.

  • Spot where AI can genuinely speed teams up, and build that into their everyday ways of working.

Requirements

  • Experience working as an Agile Coach with cross-functional, self-organising Agile teams.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, customer-centric scale-ups.
  • Experience working in a remote-first, high-performance company.
  • Deep understanding of Agile and Lean thinking, values and principles.
  • Hands-on experience applying a variety of frameworks and methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, DevOps and XP, and a track record of combining these approaches effectively.
  • Experience teaching a wide range of Agile practices such as user story mapping, event storming, example mapping, and slicing.
  • Experience coaching teams on “outcomes over output” and the adoption of continuous product discovery and delivery with a track record of helping teams improve discovery and quality practices, not just delivery speed.
  • Comfortable holding people accountable to agreed team practices - working with relevant team members to close gaps against those standards..
  • A progressive understanding of emerging Agile practices and concepts, including how AI is changing how teams work.
  • A servant-leader who gets a kick out of helping others to succeed and grow.

You'll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply:

  • You're more comfortable as a delivery or project manager than a coach - if your instinct is to manage dependencies and chase updates rather than challenge teams and remove the dependency altogether, this isn't that role

  • You need everything mapped out before you start - this is a brand new role here, still being shaped, and you'll have a hand in defining it as you go

  • You've only coached in large, rigid or enterprise environments - we're a scrappy, five-or-six-team setup, not a heavily-processed org with the infrastructure that comes with it

  • You lean on frameworks, certifications, or "doing Scrum by the book" over understanding the why - we care far more about mindset than ticking off methodology or chasing a SAFE certification

🐾 For the love of pets

Octave is looking for a Head of Data Platform & AI to lead the technical vision and execution across our data platform and emerging AI, machine learning, and Data Science capabilities. This role will own and evolve Octave’s data and AI/ML technical foundation, set the technical/strategic direction for AI/ML in close partnership with Product and cross-functional business leaders, and build the team required to execute that vision as Octave grows.

This is a leadership role for a builder. While you will set strategy, lead the team, and operate as a senior cross-functional partner, you will remain close to the technology and be expected to contribute directly to architecture, prototypes, technical evaluation, and difficult engineering problems. You will initially lead a Data Platform team and work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and business leaders across Octave.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Develops, coordinates, and implements systems, policies, procedures, and productivity standards.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to the team, ensuring the achievement of goals and objectives.
  • Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.
  • Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of projects and initiatives within the team.
  • Establish and monitor operational processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and productivity.
  • Streamline operational processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall organizational performance.
  • Implement best practices, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and develop strategies to achieve operational excellence.
  • Ensures a safe, secure, and compliant work environment.
  • Accomplishes staff results by communicating job expectations; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.
  • Build and manage a high-performing team, including hiring, training, and development.
  • Provide leadership to the team, including setting goals, providing guidance, and ensuring the team's overall success.
  • Set performance expectations and goals for team members. Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and address performance issues.
  • Identify skill gaps within the team and develop strategies for filling those gaps. Support employee development through training, mentoring, and coaching. Identify high-potential employees and create succession plans.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Define Octave’s Data & AI Technical Vision
    • Develop and own the technical strategy and roadmap for Octave’s data platform and AI/ML capabilities, while shaping company-level direction and investment priorities by bringing a data and AI perspective to decisions about where Octave competes and how it grows.
    • Own company-level KPIs spanning Octave's AI/ML and Data Platform areas — defining the measures that matter, holding accountability for outcomes against them, and reporting on progress to the executive team.
    • Partner closely with Product and cross-functional leaders to identify where AI, machine learning, and Data Science can create meaningful customer and business value, and own the technical strategy and capabilities required to bring those opportunities to life.
    • Serve as Octave’s senior technical leader and thought partner on data, AI, ML, and Data Science.
    • Help Product, Engineering, and business leaders evaluate opportunities, understand technical feasibility and tradeoffs, and shape Octave’s approach to emerging capabilities.
    • Develop a clear point of view on where traditional machine learning, predictive modeling, generative AI, LLM-based systems, and other approaches are appropriate.
    • Establish principles for when Octave should build capabilities internally, leverage third-party platforms or models, or partner externally.
    • Balance near-term delivery with the foundational investments required to support Octave’s longer-term strategy.
  • Lead AI/ML and Data Science Technical Strategy
    • Establish the technical capabilities required to develop, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production AI and machine-learning systems.
    • Work with Product and business leaders to translate promising AI/ML opportunities into well-defined technical initiatives.
    • Ensure AI/ML initiatives are grounded in clear customer or business outcomes rather than pursued as standalone technology projects.
    • Guide technical experimentation and prototyping to validate opportunities before making significant investments.
    • Establish rigorous approaches to model and system evaluation, experimentation, observability, feedback loops, governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI.
    • Determine the Data Science, ML Engineering, and Applied AI capabilities Octave needs over time and develop an appropriate organizational model to support them.
  • Own and Evolve the Data Platform
    • Own the architecture and evolution of Octave’s centralized data platform and the systems that collect, transform, store, govern, and serve data across the company.
    • Ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, observable, secure, and straightforward for downstream consumers to use.
    • Establish strong engineering practices around data quality, testing, lineage, documentation, monitoring, and reliability.
    • Build scalable interfaces and data products that enable analysts, Product, Engineering, and other teams to work effectively with trusted data.
    • Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions that balance scalability and technical quality with the speed required in a fast-growing company.
    • Avoid unnecessary complexity and ensure platform investments are justified by real customer, product, or business needs.
  • Enable a Decentralized Analytics Organization
    • Treat analysts embedded within Octave’s product and business organizations as key customers and partners of the Data Platform.
    • Partner with analysts and their leaders to understand common needs, remove technical bottlenecks, and improve access to reliable and well-modeled data.
    • Establish shared technical standards, platform capabilities, and ownership models that allow decentralized analytics teams to move quickly without creating unnecessary fragmentation.
    • Create clear ownership boundaries between the centralized Data Platform organization and embedded analytics teams.
    • Build foundational data capabilities that allow analysts to spend more time generating insights and less time solving recurring infrastructure or data-quality problems.
  • Build the Capabilities and Team Octave Needs
    • Lead, mentor, and develop the existing Data Platform team while remaining close to the technical work.
    • Continuously assess the technical capabilities required to execute Octave’s evolving data and AI strategy.
    • Develop existing team members where appropriate and recruit exceptional external talent when specialized skills or experience are missing internally.
    • Proactively identify capability gaps rather than scaling the organization through headcount alone.
    • Build additional specialized capabilities—including Data Science, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or other disciplines—as product and business needs warrant.
    • Determine when capabilities should live centrally, be embedded within Product or Engineering teams, or operate through another organizational model.
    • Develop strong technical leaders and individual contributors and create an environment characterized by high standards, ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and pragmatic execution.
    • Build an organization that can scale without introducing unnecessary layers or process.
  • Remain a Hands-On Technical Leader
    • Stay sufficiently close to the technology to provide credible technical leadership and make high-quality architecture and engineering decisions.
    • Dive into system design, architecture, data modeling, prototypes, code, technical evaluations, or production issues when your involvement can materially accelerate the team.
    • Personally engage with emerging AI/ML technologies enough to develop an informed point of view on their capabilities, limitations, and relevance to Octave.
    • Serve as a technical thought partner to Data Platform engineers, Product engineers, analysts, and senior company leadership.
    • Set a high technical bar while empowering the team to own execution.
    • Use technical depth to simplify problems and help the company avoid both underinvestment and unnecessary overengineering.

Required Skills:

  • Strong technical foundation and prior experience as a highly capable individual contributor before moving into leadership.
  • Strong understanding of traditional machine-learning and Data Science approaches and newer AI capabilities, including LLM-based systems and generative AI.
  • Strong judgment around build-versus-buy decisions and the ability to assess rapidly evolving technologies pragmatically.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to move fluidly between detailed technical discussions and conversations with senior business and product leaders.
  • Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving organization where senior leaders remain close to execution.

Education & Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience building and leading data platform, data engineering, Data Science, ML, or AI capabilities in high-growth technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and building modern data platforms and production data systems.
  • Meaningful experience applying machine learning and/or AI to real-world product or business problems and taking solutions from experimentation into production.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product teams to identify and deliver technically sophisticated product capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose organizational capability gaps, build new technical capabilities, and recruit senior, specialized technical talent to fill them.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

  • We’re human beings first. We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.
  • People deserve better than status quo. We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.
  • No bystanders. No stars. No tourists. Each person has been selected to be here, and with that comes a responsibility to bring your expertise, share your ideas, and help make this company better.
  • Partnership paves the path ahead. We don’t operate in a silo, internally or externally. To transform the system, we believe in working with others to create something bigger, better, and stronger.
  • Quality is crucial at scale. Quality is core to our business, and we refuse to sacrifice it as we grow.
  • Progress is a process. In the pursuit of progress, we iterate, reflect, learn, adjust – and always leave things better than we found them.
  • There are people behind every data point. We recognize that numbers tell only one part of the story, and we also do the work to understand impacts at the individual level.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to frequently communicate with others through virtual meeting applications such as Zoom and Google Meet.
  • Must be able to observe and communicate information on company provided laptop.
  • Move up to 10 pounds on occasion.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Partner with business leaders and end users to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics that provide actionable business insights.
  • Manage data quality through governance, deduplication, data imports, cleansing initiatives, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Support and maintain integrations between Salesforce and third-party applications using APIs, middleware, and native integration tools.
  • Coordinate testing, deployment, and release management activities for Salesforce enhancements and updates.
  • Evaluate and implement new Salesforce features, products, and capabilities, including Salesforce Einstein and AI-driven functionality.

  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and provide advanced support to users across the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of Salesforce Administration experience in a complex, enterprise environment.
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce configuration, security model, automation tools, reporting, and data management.
  • Experience gathering business requirements and delivering Salesforce solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Salesforce integrations and data synchronization processes.
  • Strong understanding of CRM best practices, governance, and data stewardship.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leveraging Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Copilot, or other AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities.

Skills & Competencies

Strong Salesforce platform expertise, business process analysis, solution design, data management, stakeholder collaboration, communication, continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to translate business challenges into scalable CRM solutions.

  • Teilnahme an unseren digitalen Team-Meetings sowie an den Lucoyo-Teamtagen (alle 3 Monate, 3 Tage in einem schönen AirBnB in NRW).

Qualifikation

Du studierst Psychologie im Bachelor (in den letzten Semestern) oder bereits im Master und möchtest dein Pflichtpraktikum bei uns absolvieren.

Erste praktische Erfahrungen (z. B. durch Praktika, Nebenjobs oder ehrenamtliches Engagement im psychologischen Bereich) sind hilfreich, aber kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Freude am Telefonkontakt mit Patient:innen hast, eine klare und empathische Kommunikation mitbringst und neugierig darauf bist, dich in Research-Themen einzubringen und diese aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Weiterbildung: Wir fördern dich so gut es geht und das auch über den Tellerand hinaus! Gemeinsam schauen wir, dass du dich in den Bereichen verbesserst, die dir wichtig sind.

Bei Lucoyo Health setzt wir uns für die Verbesserung der psychotherapeutischen Gesundheitsversorgung ein, indem wir innovative und intelligente Lösungen bereitstellen, die sowohl Praxen als auch Patient:innen unterstützen.

Wir Gründer:innen (Maja, Bastian und Robin) haben alle einen persönlichen Bezug zu Menschen mit psychischen Problemen und wissen, wie schwierig es sein kann, eine:n passende:n Psychotherapeut:in zu finden.

The right candidate combines lifecycle marketing craft, direct response instincts, experimentation rigor, platform adaptability, and unusually high personal agency. Crum & Forster Company Overview

Travel Insured International (TII), a Crum & Forster company, is hiring a Lead Infrastructure & Site Reliability Engineer.

Travel Insured International is a leading travel insurance provider with more than 30 years in business. As a key component of our Specialty Business Unit, within the Accident & Health division, TII provides travel protection plans to help each individual travel confidently. Job Description

This is a hands-on engineering role with strong leadership influence, focused on reliability and platform. You will lead through technical credibility and influence—setting standards, shaping direction, and elevating the reliability capability across engineering—while remaining deeply hands-on. As TII's Lead Infrastructure & Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the run-time reliability, observability, cloud security, and platform engineering that keep our all-Azure environment secure, resilient, and always-on—supporting the platform and business.

This is a build-and-enhance role: you will mature our observability across metrics, logs, and traces; establish disciplined incident command and blameless post-incident practices; codify infrastructure with Bicep and Terraform; harden the security posture of our Azure platform; and build the self-service platform capabilities that let engineering teams move fast safely. You will own reliability, security, and platform hands-on while partnering with engineering architecture, engineering leadership, and security stakeholders. With the AVP, Infrastructure, co-create the future-state vision and roadmap for Cloud, Observability, ITSM, and related domains making it a shared, measurable engineering discipline in support of TII's growth target and expansion into new distribution channels.

What you will do:

Infrastructure Strategy

  • Own and evolve TII's Azure infrastructure and reliability roadmap, aligned to the Azure Well-Architected Framework.
  • With the AVP, Infrastructure to co-create the future-state vision and roadmap for Cloud, Observability, ITSM, and related domains.
  • Define standards for compute, network, and platform services that scale with business growth and new channels.
  • Drive cloud cost optimization (FinOps)—balancing performance, resilience, and spend.
  • Partner with engineering architecture to ensure infrastructure enables design-time resilience and delivery velocity.

Site Reliability Engineering

  • Own run-time reliability across availability, performance, scalability, and capacity for TII's platform.
  • Mature and expand the SLO practice—defining SLIs, refining the 99.9% (and higher, where warranted) SLOs, and operating error budgets to balance reliability and delivery speed.
  • Lead capacity planning and performance engineering to support the platform's growth.
  • Drive operational readiness reviews for new services and major releases.

Observability

  • Own and mature the observability platform across the three pillars—metrics, logs, and traces—enhancing Grafana/Prometheus and Azure Application Insights.
  • Implement distributed tracing across the GraphQL/REST services to accelerate diagnosis and reduce time-to-detect and time-to-resolve.
  • Establish meaningful alerting and telemetry that reduce noise and surface real signals.
  • Build reliability dashboards that give teams and leadership clear visibility into service health.

Platform Engineering

  • Own the internal developer platform and self-service infrastructure capabilities that enable engineering teams to provision and operate safely.
  • Define golden paths / paved-road templates that make the reliable, secure, and compliant way the easy way.
  • Establish and champion Infrastructure as Code standards using Bicep and Terraform.
  • Improve developer experience and engineering enablement through automation and reusable platform services.

Operational Excellence & Automation

  • Drive automation across provisioning, configuration, deployment, and remediation to eliminate toil.
  • Establish operational runbooks, self-healing patterns, and proactive reliability practices.
  • Continuously improve deployment safety and rollback capability in partnership with CI/CD owners.

Cloud Security & Compliance

  • Own the engineering and operational security of the Azure cloud platform—including identity and access management, network security, configuration hardening, and secrets/key management.
  • Manage and improve the cloud security posture (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy), including continuous vulnerability management and remediation.
  • Implement security monitoring and alerting as part of the observability platform to detect and respond to threats.
  • Embed DevSecOps and secure-by-design practices into platform and IaC workflows, enforcing guardrails and policy-as-code within golden paths and self-service tooling.
  • Partner with the Security function on policy, governance, and compliance in a regulated insurance (PII) environment.

Incident & Problem Management

  • Own the major-incident process and incident command, matured on the on-call platform (Better Stack).
  • Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive systemic problem management to prevent recurrence.
  • Improve on-call health, escalation paths, and mean-time-to-detect / mean-time-to-resolve.
  • Maintain and enhance the mature Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery capabilities, including RTO/RPO targets and periodic testing.

Leadership

  • Will co-lead a small team of infrastructure, cloud, & system engineers.
  • Uplift the reliability and platform capability across engineering—raising standards and building a reliability culture.
  • Mentor engineers, demonstrating the leadership behaviors that support growth into a formal infrastructure leadership role.
  • Establish standards, documentation, and ways of working that scale across teams.
  • Other duties as assigned

What YOU will bring to C&F:

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and functional issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated leadership or mentoring of distributed/offshore teams (formal people-management experience a plus).
  • Excellent collaboration and influencing skills
  • Outcome & Metrics Orientation
  • Self-starter

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or related field—or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years in infrastructure, site reliability, platform, or DevOps engineering, with recent hands-on delivery.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise operating production workloads on Microsoft Azure.
  • Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code using Bicep and/or Terraform.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tooling across metrics, logs, and traces (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Application Insights).
  • Proven experience defining and operating SLIs/SLOs and error budgets.
  • Hands-on experience securing Azure cloud environments—identity/access, network security, posture management (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy), and vulnerability management.
  • Experience scaling Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Purview.
  • Experience owning incident management, on-call, and blameless post-incident reviews (e.g., Better Stack, PagerDuty, or comparable).
  • Strong scripting/automation ability (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) and CI/CD experience (Azure DevOps preferred).
  • Experience supporting business continuity and disaster recovery with defined RTO/RPO.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, golden paths, and self-service infrastructure.
  • Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted operations (AIOps) and modern reliability automation.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Security Engineer Associate) preferred.
  • Experience in insurance, travel, fintech, or SaaS (regulated environments) preferred.
  • Prior leadership or mentoring of distributed/offshore teams desired. Formal people-leadership experience a plus

What C&F will bring to you

  • Generous 401K employer match

  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing

At C&F you will BELONG

Description

Insycle is looking for a Customer Success Engineer to own a portfolio of customers across onboarding, active use, and renewal, and expansion. Two steps are required:

  1. Submit the application using the job board.
  2. Complete the Loom video in the Application Questionnaire. The reason that we ask for a Loom video is to see how you communicate via video, because this is a key part of this role. We often communicate with customers using tools like Loom and Zoom, so it's important that you're comfortable communicating this way.

Link to Questionnaire:

Company Overview

At Insycle, our mission is to make it easy to manage and work with data.

Insycle – a modern platform to organize, cleanse, and manage CRM data – is a beloved SaaS product used by thousands of users from more than 80 countries. Product overview video:

We’re headquartered in New York City.

Requirements

✅ You’re a Fit If You…

  • Are a self-starter with a bias to action. You see what’s needed, take ownership, and create improvements without being asked.
  • Are hungry to improve processes and move the company forward; you notice patterns, propose scalable fixes, and follow through.
  • Are curious but intentional. You ask great questions, form hypotheses, test quickly, and measure impact.
  • Have 3+ years in Customer Success, onboarding, solutions consulting, or a similar technical, customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company.

  • Are highly technical, with the ability to learn quickly and become a product expert.
  • Are comfortable with CRMs and data workflows (HubSpot or Salesforce), and you can troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Have experience partnering with RevOps or data teams, acting as a hands-on strategic advisor.
  • Enjoy collaborating, stay positive and energetic under pressure, and embody being helpful in every interaction.
  • Align with our mission: make working with data easy, fun, and not scary.

🚫 This Role Isn’t for You If…

  • You prefer to work strictly from a script or only handle basic questions.
  • Ambiguity drains you, or you hesitate to wear different hats in a fast-moving startup.
  • You resist change or adopting new processes.
  • You wait for direction rather than proactively identifying problems and proposing solutions.
  • You're uncomfortable asking customers questions and providing strategic guidance.

  • Drive adoption: Help customers scale from one-off cleanup to Insycle as the core, governed data layer for their CRM. Drive new use cases (additional workflows, teams, data objects).

  • Provide expert validation: Act as a second set of eyes on complex setups. Flag potential issues before they become problems.
  • Deliver high-signal insights: Share patterns and best practices seen across similar customers. Help customers understand what “good” looks like at their scale.
  • Support value communication: Help customers articulate impact and return on invetsment internally (time saved, risk reduced, data quality improvements). Provide clear summaries for renewals and budget justification.

  • Pursue at-risk accounts: Engage non-renewing customers. Lead outreach efforts and craft targeted offers to re-engage and retain them.
  • Inform key stakeholders: Liaise with all stakeholders to address any gaps and ensure alignment with broader company initiatives.
  • Handle objections: Speak credibly to competitive objections, addressing all concerns with concrete differentiation and technical explanations

Qualities We're Looking For

Why This Role Is Exciting

You’ll be on the front lines of a product customers love, and you’ll help them master it. Your ideas will directly shape our processes, product, and customer experience. We’re a small team with a big mission, so your voice will matter and your work will have visible impact.

National Debt Relief is seeking a Manager of Sales Analytics to serve as a key analytical partner to the sales organization. This is an individual contributor role. In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of data and strategy. You'll be expected to dig into the "why" behind the numbers surfacing trends, diagnosing performance gaps, and identifying opportunities that aren't immediately obvious from a surface-level view of the data. From there, you'll work directly with sales leadership to shape strategy: informing decisions, agent performance initiatives, and process improvements.

This role is well-suited to someone who enjoys ownership and wants their analytical work to have visible, tangible impact. You'll move fluidly between hands-on data work (writing queries, building dashboards, validating data integrity) and higher-level strategic conversations with sales leadership about where the business should focus next. Success in this role means sales leaders trust your insights, come to you with open-ended business questions, and treat you as a thought partner rather than just a report-builder.
