jobs.excerpt: About Elevate Elevate is a small business providing comprehensive grant writing support to nearly 100 nonprofit organizations working on a wide variety of issues.
jobs.description:
About Elevate

Elevate is a small business providing comprehensive grant writing support to nearly 100 nonprofit organizations working on a wide variety of issues. Our fully-remote staff work on teams and build long-term partnerships with clients to support every stage of the grant cycle: fundraising strategy & goal development, prospect research and cultivation, drafting and submission, and funder stewardship. All staff work remotely, with the option to visit our co-working space in downtown DC or meet with clients and teams in-person provided that these activities align with our COVID-19 policies. All candidates must be legally authorized to work for Elevate, and must work for Elevate, in the United States.

Staff benefit from flexible scheduling, built-in mentorship and support from colleagues on their client teams, a dedicated supervisor responsible for training and professional growth, established career development pathways that outline clear expectations for current and future positions within the company, and the opportunity to work with a portfolio of clients that align with their interests or provide exposure to new social change issues.

For more information about our organizational culture and the clients we serve, visit our websitehere.

Overview of the Position

For this role, Elevate seeks skilled institutional fundraising professionals with the confidence, flexibility, and persistence to coach clients on best-practices in fundraising strategy, grant writing, financials, and program evaluation while overseeing junior staff who produce compelling proposals and manage detailed grants calendars. Directors work independently to oversee 5-6 client teams at a time. They meet regularly with a dedicated Supervisor to report progress toward client goals, request support managing their teams, and to identify potential obstacles to a successful long-term client partnership for Elevate’s Client Services department.

Strong candidates have at least four years of experience or comparable experience with the key tasks and responsibilities listed below and demonstrated ability to meet the key competencies for the role.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Lead 4-5 client teams while overseeing the work of junior staff;
  • Develop and implement comprehensive institutional fundraising strategies in close partnership with clients that establish short- and long-term goals, prospecting priorities, and systems for cultivation and stewardship;
  • Lean on impeccable project management skills to ensure prospect research, cultivation, solicitation, and grand calendar management deliverables are completed on time and at a consistently high quality for each client;
  • Manage early career development professionals who are eager to learn from you about institutional fundraising;
  • Draft select proposals, reports, LOIs, and concept papers to ensure highly strategic writing on the most complex deliverables.
  • Contribute positively to Elevate’s culture, commitment to equity and inclusion, and company values.

Key Competencies

Fundraising & Nonprofit Expertise. You develop and clearly articulate strong institutional fundraising strategies for clients that work in at least two issue areas or funder landscapes. You demonstrate exemplary, strengths-based writing skills and work to understand the root causes of the challenges facing your client organizations' beneficiaries; demonstrate a command of program design sufficient to guide clients in the development of competitive funding proposals, even for programs and interventions that are new to you. You demonstrate a comfort with budgets, basic program evaluation, and other common grant attachments. You efficiently research well-aligned funding opportunities for different organizational needs and support the cultivation of funders with concise cultivation emails and talking points that demonstrate a nuanced understanding of the funding landscape and individual funder's interests. You work effectively with your teams and clients to maintain accurate, comprehensive, and regularly updated Salesforce records that support high quality grant calendars and data analysis.

Team Management. You demonstrate standard management skills which includes all standard Elevate processes (1:1s, task delegation, and oversight), consistent and timely feedback, and proactive approach to solving problems within the team. You identify potential performance challenges on your teams and discuss them with your supervisor. You facilitate an inclusive environment that’s welcoming to all.

Problem Solving. You support team members who identify incomplete, inaccurate, or inconsistent program information that impacts the quality of our grants, helping to identify problems and develop solutions collaboratively. You check-in regularly with team members to ensure work products are on track for a timely submission and plan for contingencies in which needed information, data, or reviews are unavailable. You are comfortable addressing or adapting your strategy to common barriers to fundraising success, including, for example, minimal impact data or evaluation practices, weaknesses in organizational program/project budgeting, and limited staff capacity.

Consulting & Professional Communication. You independently present complex problems, goals, and ideas in a way that is accessible even to those unfamiliar with Elevate's work, such as program, finance, and evaluation staff. You introduce client points of contact to best-practices in fundraising strategy, budget development, measurement and evaluation, and organizational planning/sustainability. You proactively identify potential obstacles in the Elevate/Client relationship and work with a supervisor to address them.

Timeliness & Prioritization. You support your team while consistently delivering on projects, and communicate promptly to set expectations appropriately. You are accountable for the quality and timeliness of all work products you deliver to the client.

Information Processing. You independently implement an efficient and effective system for tracking and updating information relevant to your work. You independently identify information and data needs and fill them by finding what you need in Elevate's information systems (Dropbox, Salesforce, Google Groups, etc.), asking targeted questions in internal check-ins, and reaching out directly to the client. You recommend new tools and systems to better track information and data on your client teams.

Attention to Detail. You are accountable for all details in your team's work products. You catch details that other team members have overlooked or included in error. Clients rarely identify missing or inaccurate information that you did not already flag for their review.

Tools and Systems. You adhere to and consistently use Elevate's standard tools and systems; You know what information is logged in Salesforce by default and what information can be logged by request.

Continuous Learning. You proactively request feedback from others and are open to continuous constructive feedback. You consistently deliver useful feedback on both overall performance and specific deliverables to your peers and manager in a way that strengthens relationships and enables projects to advance more efficiently or effectively.

Compensation and Benefits

The annual salary for this full-time position is $72,500 and is based on a market analysis of comparable job duties and positions within the nonprofit sector and across a variety of United States geographies. Due to our commitment to internal parity within each position and across the company, we do not negotiate salaries.

In addition to this base compensation and flexible work schedule, we offer a generous benefits package to all staff, including:

  • Health insurance: On average, Elevate pays over 94% of the medical premium, 80% of the dental premium, and 80% of the vision premium for employees only. Dependent coverage is the full responsibility of individual employees.
  • Paid time off: 15 days’ vacation, 8 sick days, 12 company holidays, 24 hours of voting leave and civic engagement leave.
  • Winter Break: The office typically closes in the last week of the calendar year (between December 24 and January 2nd). Employees can choose to take the full break or apply some of this time for religious observance days (up to three) at other times of the year.
  • Summer Break : The office typically closes the first week of July.
  • Sabbatical Leave: Staff with six years of FT service or more are eligible for a 4-week (21 day) paid sabbatical.
  • 401(k) retirement plan- We offer a 2% employer match after the first year of employment.
  • Reimbursements for your personal cell phone and home internet
  • A $200 initial office set up stipend with an additional $100 stipend annually
  • A $500 annual professional development stipend, in addition to a robust and growing internal training program provided free to staff.

Hiring Process

All applicants should apply via our Rippling hiring platform. You are asked to provide an updated resume, as well as a cover letter that should detail the following:

  • Relevant skills and experience;
  • Your interest in the position, including your interest in advancing in your career at Elevate, specifically;
  • Your professional strengths;
  • Evidence of your alignment with our company values.

Based on these materials, a hiring manager will contact you with next steps on a rolling basis. Applicants whose experiences and qualifications are strongly aligned with the position will be asked to complete a hiring exercise designed to assess your fundraising strategy and grant writing skills, as well as an interview process that will include at least two interviews prior to final decisions.

We accept applications and hire on a rolling basis that is aligned with our staffing needs for new clients and projects. This process can take anywhere from one to three months from application to start date. Additionally, we use Rippling to communicate with our applicants throughout the hiring process. Please take a moment to add emails from @ats.rippling.com as a safe sender before submitting your application. If you do not, emails may be directed to your spam folder, or may not reach you at all.

Elevate provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment, without regard to race, creed, ancestry, citizenship, religion, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, family responsibilities, age, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, genetic information, status as a victim of domestic violence, marital status, disability, personal appearance or any other protected characteristic or status under applicable federal, state and local laws. Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

The opportunity

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Southern New Hampshire University is seeking a student employee to fill the role of English Teacher for Adults for our partner organization Intercambio Uniting Communities. Intercambio Uniting Communities is seeking dedicated and passionate individuals to serve as English teachers for individual online instruction with adult English learners. As an Online teacher, you will play a vital role in helping learner improve their English language skills, enhancing their confidence, and building life-changing connections.

Job Responsibilities

  • Teaching English: Using Intercambio’s relationship-based adult online ESL curriculum, Confidence and Connections, Online teachers plan and deliver English lessons to one learner. Online Teachers use the Intercambio Learning System to lead interactive, fun, and engaging lessons, while promoting a cooperative learning environment.
  • Fostering Cultural Connections: Online teachers embrace the “Intercambio Way” which promotes opportunities for learners and teachers to learn from each other about their cultures, perspectives, experiences, and traditions while learning and teaching English.

Minimum Qualification

  • Current enrollment in classes as part of a SNHU degree program
  • Work study part of financial aid package
  • Students with work study may be prioritized
  • Passion for building community, teaching English, and helping learners succeed.
  • Patience, empathy, a positive attitude, and a spirit of life-long learning.
  • Basic computer knowledge to use a video-conferencing platform, similar to Zoom, to conduct online classes (working camera and microphone).
  • Do not need to speak a language other than English.
  • No prior teaching or tutoring experience in English required. Our materials are designed to be used by people of all different backgrounds and to make it as easy as possible for anyone with patience, enthusiasm, and a desire to learn and connect with others to teach English.
  • Designated time in your schedule to hold two 90-minute classes per week, plus about 30 minutes for lesson preparation. Intercambio will find a learner who you can meet at the time you are available. If you have more than 4 hours a week, you can teach more than one learner!

Time Commitment

  • Online teachers meet with their students for 90 minutes, 2 times a week to complete at least two Confidence and Curriculum books (about a 6-month commitment). After completing two books, Online teachers are encouraged to continue with their students for subsequent books.
  • The class schedule is based on the availability provided by teachers and learners.

Training and Ongoing Support:

  • All Online Teachers must complete Intercambio’s training for new teachers, which includes approximately 8 hours of online training video modules that can be completed independently and one 2-hour live Zoom online training session. Upon successful completion of this training, trained teachers will receive a certificate of completion from Intercambio for to become an English teacher for adults.
  • In addition to the required training for Online teachers, Intercambio also provides ongoing workshops, Teacher Connection Hours, and a summer conference to help support teachers to continue to improve their skills. These sessions are recommended but not required.

Learning Outcomes

This is a perfect position for anyone considering teaching, living abroad, working in global business, or just curious about other people and their cultures. Skills learned such as time management, organization of work, and communication will help give an excellent foundation for any future career.


We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented Video Editor who can turn raw footage into polished, engaging content that captures attention and communicates a clear message.

You’ll work across a variety of video formats, including short-form social content, advertisements, promotional videos, educational content, testimonials, and longer-form videos. The ideal candidate understands both the technical side of editing and the creative side of storytelling, pacing, hooks, and audience retention.

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit raw footage into polished, professional videos aligned with brand guidelines and creative direction.
  • Create engaging short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.
  • Edit long-form content such as YouTube videos, interviews, podcasts, webinars, and educational content.
  • Build strong hooks and maintain effective pacing to improve viewer engagement and retention.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, sound effects, music, B-roll, and other visual elements where appropriate.
  • Perform basic color correction and color grading to maintain a consistent visual style.
  • Clean, mix, and balance audio for professional-quality output.
  • Repurpose long-form footage into multiple short-form pieces of content.
  • Follow creative briefs while also recommending edits and creative approaches that improve the final product.
  • Organize project files, raw footage, graphics, audio, and exported assets efficiently.
  • Manage multiple editing projects and meet agreed-upon deadlines.
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Stay current with social media editing styles, platform trends, formats, and content best practices.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both creative and technical editing ability.
  • Advanced proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar professional editing software.
  • Experience editing short-form social media content.
  • Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks, and viewer retention.
  • Experience with captions, motion graphics, B-roll, transitions, and sound design.
  • Working knowledge of color correction and audio editing.
  • Ability to take raw footage and independently determine how to structure it into an engaging final video.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control.
  • Ability to follow brand guidelines and maintain consistency across content.
  • Strong organizational and file-management skills.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and completing revisions.
  • Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Adobe After Effects or other motion graphics software.
  • Experience creating paid social/video advertisements.
  • Experience editing podcasts or talking-head content.
  • Experience creating thumbnails or basic graphics using Photoshop, Canva, or similar tools.

What We're Looking For

We are not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together. We want an editor who understands why people keep watching.

You should be comfortable working independently while still following the overall creative direction of the brand.

  • Your portfolio or editing reel.
  • Examples of short-form and long-form videos you personally edited.

  • A brief explanation of your editing process from receiving raw footage to delivering the final video.

Job Title: Budgeting/Forecasting Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. client business hours

About the Role:

Our client is seeking a Budgeting/Forecasting Specialist to build financial models, manage planning cycles, and provide forward-looking insights that guide strategy. This role requires strong analytical skills, mastery of modeling tools, and the ability to translate numbers into actionable recommendations. You will work closely with finance leaders and department heads to ensure budgets and forecasts are accurate, realistic, and strategically aligned.

Responsibilities:

Budget Development:

    • Lead preparation of annual operating and capital budgets.
    • Consolidate inputs across departments and business units.
    • Ensure budgets align with company goals and resource constraints.

Forecasting:

    • Maintain rolling forecasts for revenue, expenses, and cash flow.
    • Update models monthly or quarterly with actuals, adjusting assumptions.
    • Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to test potential outcomes.

Variance Analysis:

    • Compare actual results to budgets/forecasts.
    • Prepare written commentary to explain variances and recommend corrective actions.

Financial Modeling:

    • Build dynamic Excel or Google Sheets models (DCF, ROI, IRR, break-even).
    • Use advanced formulas, macros, or BI tool integrations to improve accuracy.

Reporting:

    • Prepare management reporting packages with dashboards and visualizations.
    • Present insights to executives, highlighting risks and opportunities.

Collaboration:

    • Partner with department heads to align forecasts with operational plans.
    • Work with FP&A teams to refine planning assumptions.

Process Improvement:

    • Identify inefficiencies in forecasting workflows.
    • Implement new FP&A software or improve data integrations (Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, Workday, or equivalent).

What Makes You a Perfect Fit:

  • Highly analytical with an eye for detail.
  • Comfortable building models from scratch and explaining them simply.
  • Proactive in identifying trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Skilled communicator who can influence leaders through data-driven storytelling.

Required Experience & Skills (Minimum):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • 3+ years in financial planning/analysis, budgeting, or forecasting.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets (nested formulas, pivot tables, sensitivity modeling).
  • Experience preparing variance analyses for leadership.

Ideal Experience & Skills:

  • FP&A tool experience (Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Hyperion, Workday).
  • MBA, CFA, or CPA credential.
  • Experience forecasting for SaaS, real estate, or professional services.
  • Familiarity with BI/analytics platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Budgeting/Forecasting Specialist’s day revolves around building clarity about the future of the business. You will:

  • Maintain financial models — updating them with actuals and revising assumptions based on market or internal trends.
  • Analyze variances — reviewing how actual results differ from plan and preparing written explanations with supporting data.
  • Support decision-making — running scenario analyses (“what happens if revenue grows 15%?” “what if headcount increases by 20?”) and presenting implications to leadership.
  • Collaborate across teams — meeting with department managers to validate budget assumptions and ensure spending aligns with strategy.
  • Deliver reporting — packaging forecasts and analyses into dashboards and executive-ready presentations.
  • Continuously improve — refining models, implementing forecasting software, and streamlining inputs to shorten cycles.

In essence: the role is about ensuring the organization has reliable forward-looking data to guide strategy, supported by strong financial models and clear commentary.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs):

  • Forecast accuracy within ±5–10%.
  • Budget completion within agreed timelines.
  • Variance explanations delivered within 2–3 days of close.
  • Models updated regularly and free from errors.
  • Forecasting cycle time is reduced via automation.

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Task (e.g., build a simple forecast model and run sensitivity analysis)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Job Title: Data Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (with flexibility for pipeline monitoring, deployments, and data refresh cycles)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and reliable data pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making across the business.

This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, deep experience with modern data stacks, and a passion for building clean, reliable, and high-performance data systems. The Data Engineer will ensure data flows seamlessly from source systems into warehouses, dashboards, and downstream applications while maintaining high standards for quality, governance, and scalability.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver trustworthy and actionable data.

Responsibilities

Pipeline Development & Data Integration

  • Build, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, or Scala
    • Orchestrate workflows using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools
    • Ingest structured and unstructured data from APIs, SaaS platforms, databases, files, and streaming systems
    • Develop scalable connectors and automated ingestion workflows

Data Warehousing & Modeling

  • Manage and optimize cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift
    • Design scalable schemas using star and snowflake modeling techniques
    • Implement partitioning, clustering, indexing, and performance optimization strategies
    • Build clean, analytics-ready datasets for business intelligence and reporting use cases

Data Quality, Governance & Reliability

  • Implement validation checks, anomaly detection, logging, and monitoring to ensure data integrity
    • Enforce naming conventions, lineage tracking, and documentation standards using tools such as dbt or Great Expectations
    • Maintain audit-ready data processes and ensure compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, or industry-specific requirements
    • Monitor pipeline health and proactively resolve failures or inconsistencies

Streaming & Real-Time Data Processing

  • Build and manage real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or similar platforms
    • Support low-latency ingestion and event-driven architectures for time-sensitive applications
    • Monitor streaming infrastructure and optimize throughput and reliability

Collaboration & Analytics Enablement

  • Partner closely with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable datasets
    • Support dashboard and reporting initiatives across Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
    • Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions and models
    • Maintain clear technical documentation for pipelines, schemas, and workflows

Infrastructure, DevOps & Automation

  • Containerize data services using Docker and manage deployments through Kubernetes when applicable
    • Automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI
    • Manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • Continuously optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud costs

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Passionate about building clean, reliable, and scalable data systems
    • Strong debugging and problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail
    • Balance of software engineering discipline and analytical thinking
    • Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Proactive communicator who takes ownership of data quality and reliability

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Back-End Engineering, or Data Infrastructure roles

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL

  • Experience with at least one modern data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery)
    • Hands-on experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect
    • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and data transformation workflows
    • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience with dbt for data modeling and transformation management
    • Streaming and event-driven data pipeline experience (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub)
    • Experience with cloud-native data services such as AWS Glue, GCP Dataflow, or Azure Data Factory
    • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or CI/CD workflows
    • Background in regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, or enterprise SaaS
    • Experience optimizing warehouse costs and query performance at scale

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Data Engineer’s day revolves around maintaining reliable pipelines, improving data quality, and enabling teams with scalable access to trustworthy data. You will:

  • Monitor pipeline health and troubleshoot failed jobs in Airflow or related orchestration systems
    • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for APIs, SaaS platforms, and operational databases
    • Optimize SQL queries and warehouse performance to improve efficiency and reduce cloud costs
    • Collaborate with analysts and data scientists to provide curated datasets for reporting and modeling
    • Implement validation checks and monitoring to prevent downstream data quality issues
    • Document data models, transformations, and workflows to ensure scalability and maintainability

In essence: you ensure the organization has accurate, timely, and reliable data powering operational, analytical, and strategic decisions.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

• Pipeline uptime ≥ 99%

  • Data freshness maintained within agreed SLAs
    • Zero critical data quality issues reaching downstream reporting systems
    • Improved warehouse query performance and cost optimization
    • Timely delivery of scalable and reliable datasets
    • Positive feedback from analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Technical Assessment (e.g., build a small ETL pipeline or optimize a SQL query)

This is a remote position.

About Webgility

Webgility builds ecommerce-to-accounting automation for US-based SMB and mid-market sellers. We sit at the intersection of ecommerce, accounting, and fintech — a problem nearly every online seller eventually runs into, and one that gets more painful, not less, as they scale.

About the Role

Every growing e-commerce seller in the US hits the same wall: their storefronts (Shopify, Amazon, Walmart) and their books (QuickBooks, NetSuite) don't talk to each other. What starts as a spreadsheet workaround becomes hours of manual reconciliation, miscategorized transactions, and month-end panic. Webgility closes that gap automatically and increasingly, with AI doing more of the work itself.

This Senior PM role sits at the center of that shift: you'll decide what "the software does it for you" actually means for a Webgility seller, and you'll own it end to end.

You'll own a defined slice of the platform from customer problem to shipped, adopted feature, working daily with engineering, design, and customer support, and at launch with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

A growing share of what you own is AI-native by design: you'll define what the system should just handle, what it should flag, and what it should ask a human to confirm shaping how AI works inside real seller workflows.

You'll also work in an org that uses AI as its own day-to-day operating layer we build with agentic tooling internally as much as we ship it externally, so you'll be expected to work AI-first yourself, not just spec AI for others to build.


Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap and day-to-day execution for your product area end-to-end

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered capabilities in that area — from automated categorization and anomaly detection to agentic workflows that act on sellers' behalf

  • Partner with engineering and AI teams to turn real seller pain points into AI features that are genuinely useful and trustworthy not AI for its own sake including defining what "good" looks like and how you'll measure it

  • Run customer discovery directly with US-based SMB and mid-market ecommerce sellers interviews, usage data, support/CS feedback loops

  • Write clear specs and partner tightly with engineering and design through build and ship

  • Define success metrics for your area (adoption, activation, retention) and report on them honestly, including when something isn't working

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success on go-to-market positioning, launch, and rollout for what you ship

  • Triage the constant stream of inbound requests without losing sight of the roadmap

What You Bring

  • 10+ years total experience, with meaningful time in B2B SaaS product management

  • Experience building products for a US customer base

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features in a B2B SaaS product from problem framing through measurable adoption

  • Comfortable running your own customer discovery, without a dedicated research team

  • Metrics literacy: you can define, track, and defend the numbers behind your prioritization calls

  • Strong written communication — specs and cross-functional updates that don't need a meeting to be understood

  • You use AI tools in your own day-to-day work research, writing, analysis, prototyping and expect to keep doing so here

Preferred Experience

  • Ecommerce and accounting/financial software you understand both sides of the sync problem we solve, not just one

  • Direct experience with SMB or mid-market customers — not purely enterprise, low-volume accounts

Location & Compensation

India-based, remote-friendly. Compensation is competitive and based on experience.


Benefits

Why Join Webgility
  • Remote-first with flexible working
  • Group health insurance (employee, spouse, children)​
  • Internet reimbursement
  • Learning and development support including certification costs

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Position Overview

MetroSys is seeking an experienced OT/SCADA Deployment Engineer to support a large-scale rollout of the Inductive Automation Ignition SCADA platform across multiple industrial locations.

The consultant will work closely with the client's OT and architecture teams to deploy a standardized Ignition environment using established architecture, templates, configurations, and a client-developed "gold image." This role will focus primarily on implementation, site configuration, equipment connectivity, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning rather than developing the overall platform architecture.

Prior hands-on Ignition experience is highly desirable but not required. Candidates with a strong background in SCADA, industrial controls, PLCs, industrial automation, and OT environments who can quickly learn the client's standardized Ignition deployment model will be considered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy and configure standardized Ignition SCADA environments across multiple industrial sites.
  • Install and configure Ignition components using client-provided architecture, templates, standards, and gold-image configurations.
  • Configure site-specific SCADA settings and adapt standardized templates to individual plant requirements.
  • Connect Ignition to PLCs, controllers, industrial equipment, databases, historians, and other OT systems.
  • Configure and validate device connections, tags, communications, alarms, templates, and related SCADA components.
  • Troubleshoot communication issues between SCADA servers, PLCs, field devices, networks, and other OT systems.
  • Work with plant controls engineers, OT teams, network engineers, and centralized architecture resources during deployments.
  • Perform system testing, validation, commissioning, and production-readiness activities prior to site turnover.
  • Identify and resolve deployment issues while maintaining consistency with established global architecture standards.
  • Document configurations, deployment procedures, site-specific changes, troubleshooting steps, and as-built environments.
  • Provide feedback to the architecture team to improve deployment templates and repeatable rollout processes.
  • Support multiple deployments as the program expands across additional locations globally.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience working with SCADA, industrial controls, OT systems, or industrial automation.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, commissioning, or supporting SCADA/HMI environments.
  • Experience connecting SCADA systems to PLCs, controllers, field devices, and industrial equipment.
  • Understanding of industrial communication protocols such as OPC/OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, MQTT, or similar technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting communications between field equipment, control systems, networks, and SCADA platforms.
  • Understanding of industrial networking, IP addressing, switching, firewalls, and connectivity within OT environments.
  • Ability to follow standardized architecture and deployment procedures while adapting configurations to individual sites.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with centralized engineering and architecture teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Inductive Automation Ignition.
  • Ignition Core or Gold Certification.
  • Experience with other SCADA/HMI platforms such as Rockwell FactoryTalk, AVEVA/Wonderware, Siemens WinCC, GE iFIX/CIMPLICITY, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider, or other industrial PLC platforms.
  • Experience deploying systems across multiple manufacturing or industrial locations.
  • Experience with historians, SQL databases, industrial data collection, alarming, and visualization.
  • Familiarity with OT cybersecurity and network segmentation best practices.
  • Experience supporting large-scale or global industrial technology deployments.

We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Migration Lead with strong expertise to lead the data migration workstream for our SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementation. The Data Migration Lead will serve as the primary point of contact for all migration-related activities, partnering closely with the System Integrator (SI), business process owners, functional teams, and legacy system stakeholders.

This role is accountable for establishing migration strategy, governance, scope, work execution plan, data readiness, business alignment, issue resolution, and migration-cycle oversight while ensuring business-owned data is prepared, validated, approved, and ready for successful migration to SAP S/4HANA. This role is also responsible for the migration of historical data to meet compliance and operational requirements.

Original Composites & Fiberglass is a business unit of the Praana Group and was recently acquired by the Praana Group. The path ahead will be dynamic, full of change, and expected to be fast paced. The business operates from twenty (20+) locations across the globe. The information technology environment supporting our new company is being built from the ground up in terms of IT infrastructure and applications with the opportunity to leverage new technologies and new ways of thinking as we look to end a transition services agreement associated with the acquisition as soon as possible. Our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) landscape is comprised of multiple instances across the globe. We seek to consolidate and simplify our ERP landscape to drive efficiency and effectiveness in our operations for decades ahead.

Key Responsibilities
Data Strategy & Governance
  • Define Original Composites & Fiberglass’s data migration strategy, scope, governance, and success criteria. Drive readiness, issue resolution, escalations, and business sign-off.
Business & Stakeholder Leadership
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Original Composites & Fiberglass, the SI, business process owners, and functional teams for all Data matters. Align stakeholders, facilitate decisions, and manage dependencies.
Data Readiness & Quality
  • Oversee data migration scope, data quality, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation readiness. Ensure business-owned data issues are addressed and approved before migration.
Migration Planning & Execution
  • Lead planning, work execution plan, and coordination of migration cycles, including SIT, UAT, mock conversions, and production migration. Track readiness, risks, defects, and cycle outcomes.
Cutover & Go-Live Support
  • Partner with the Cutover Lead to plan and execute migration activities. Coordinate final validation, reconciliation, business sign-off, and post-go-live support.
Vendor & SI Management
  • Oversee SI data deliverables, timelines, and quality expectations. Challenge assumptions, remove roadblocks, and ensure successful delivery of migration objectives.
Key Deliverables
  • Data Migration Strategy & Governance Framework
  • Migration Scope, Object Inventory, and Source System Inventory
  • Migration Roadmap and Work Execution Plan
  • Data Readiness and Quality Dashboards
  • Migration Risk, Issue, and Dependency Logs
  • Migration Cycle and Validation Plans
  • Reconciliation and Sign-Off Framework
  • Cutover Data Migration Plan
  • Migration Readiness Assessments
  • Business Data Approval and Final Sign-Off Documentation
  • Data History Migration and Plan
Qualifications & Requirements
  • 8+ years of SAP or ERP data migration experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading SAP S/4HANA data migration workstreams, preferably in Greenfield programs.
  • Strong understanding of SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA master and transactional data.
  • Experience working with System Integrators and managing migration governance.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, data governance, validation, reconciliation, and business sign-off processes.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, planning, risk management, and issue-resolution skills.
Preferred Qualifications & Experience
  • Manufacturing industry experience.
  • Experience managing migrations from multiple SAP legacy environments.
  • Experience with SAP Migration Cockpit, SAP MDG, and data governance initiatives.
  • Experience supporting large-scale ERP cutover and go-live activities.
  • Experience using data migration tools to improve data quality and reduce the time required.
  • Experience using AI-enabled technologies to improve data quality a plus qualification.
  • Familiarity with SAP BTP, integration platforms, and enterprise data management solutions.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Benefits Consultant to join our fully remote team. The Benefits Consultant owns the full lifecycle of benefits and 401(k) administration across a portfolio of small and mid-sized employers. This role blends hands-on plan administration with consultative guidance — helping clients design, implement, and run benefits programs that fit their workforce, budget, and compliance obligations. The ideal candidate comes from a brokerage or benefits consulting background and is comfortable shifting between strategic plan design conversations and the operational details of enrollment, billing, and carrier coordination. This is a permanent part-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who wants RCR to be their work - not a side engagement alongside other employment or their own consulting practice.

The Schedule
Core hours are 9:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Eastern, when we need you reachable for clients. The remaining hours each week are yours to place — early mornings, evenings, whatever fits your life. We hold this schedule seriously; it is the reason the role exists as part-time rather than full-time.
We do ask for flexibility to pick up additional hours occasionally when client needs spike — open enrollment, an implementation go-live, an urgent employee relations matter.

Health & Welfare Benefits Administration
  • Manage day-to-day administration of medical, dental, vision, life, disability, voluntary, FSA/HSA, and COBRA programs across multiple client groups
  • Lead annual open enrollment from start to finish — strategy, communications, system build, employee education sessions, and post-enrollment audits
  • Process new hire enrollments, qualifying life events, and terminations; coordinate with carriers, payroll, and HRIS platforms
  • Reconcile carrier invoices and resolve eligibility, billing, and claims escalations
  • Maintain plan documents, SPDs, SBCs, and required compliance notices

  • Administer 401(k) plans including enrollments, contribution changes, loans, distributions, and rollovers
  • Coordinate payroll-to-recordkeeper data flows; reconcile contributions and resolve discrepancies across platforms like Guideline, Paycom, Gusto, and Paylocity
  • Support plan audits, year-end compliance testing, Form 5500 filings, and required participant disclosures
  • Partner with plan advisors and recordkeepers on plan design changes, fund reviews, and fiduciary best practices

Employee Communications and Education
  • Build and deliver benefits communications, enrollment guides, and education sessions tailored to each client's culture and audience

  • Prior experience working in a fully remote role

  • Experience supporting multiple client accounts simultaneously

Job Description:

Manager, Partner Operations , SolveStudio

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers' toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You'll Make in this Role

The Manager, Partner Operations serves as the operational hub connecting Solve Studio, external agency partners and project teams. This role oversees agency partner governance, resource planning and work routing to ensure work is delivered through the most effective and efficient delivery model. By maintaining visibility across internal capacity, partner capabilities and business demand, this individual helps optimize delivery, improve utilization and ensure consistent execution across the marketing ecosystem.

The Manager, Partner Operations plays a critical role in determining how work is staffed and delivered, balancing business priorities, resource availability, agency capabilities and operational efficiency to support Solve Studio's business objectives.

This role helps shape the future operating model of Solve Studio by creating a scalable approach to resource planning, agency engagement and delivery optimization.

Key responsibilities

Agency Partner Operations and Governance

  • Build trusted working relationships with approved agency partners and serve as the primary operational contact.

  • Monitor partner performance, utilization and effectiveness to inform future staffing and investment decisions.

  • Support agency selection and engagement recommendations based on capability, performance, capacity, and business needs.

  • Drive consistency in how external partners are onboarded, engaged, and evaluated across Solve Studio.

  • Support the transition to a centrally managed network of approved agency partners.

  • Establish and maintain agency onboarding, operating standards, governance tools, documentation and escalation paths.

  • Maintain a centralized roster of partner capabilities, geographic coverage, rates, contract status, contacts and engagement requirements.

  • Serve as the central operational contact for approved partners, routing commercial, contractual and compliance matters through Solve Studio leadership and Procurement.

  • Coordinate agency business reviews and maintain consistent scorecards, reporting and performance-improvement actions.

  • Maintain visibility to agency assignments, utilization, scopes, purchase orders, spend and retainers in partnership with Operations, Finance and Procurement.

  • Support retainer and partner network recommendations based on performance, demand, capability, and value.

Work Routing & Resource Planning

  • Resource Planning & Delivery Optimization

  • Maintain a holistic view of project demand, internal capacity, agency capacity and upcoming business needs.

  • Recommend the optimal delivery model for incoming work, including internal staffing, agency engagement or blended teams.

  • Match work to the appropriate resources based on capability, availability, complexity, continuity, and business priorities.

  • Lead resource allocation discussions across active and upcoming work.

  • Identify capacity risks, capability gaps and workload imbalances and proactively recommend solutions.

  • Partner with Operations, Project Management and leadership teams to support forecasting and workforce planning.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher AND 7 years of experience in agency operations, creative operations, resource management, studio management, marketing operations or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience managing resource allocation, capacity planning and staffing decisions across multiple concurrent projects, portfolios or business groups.

  • Experience supporting or managing agency partners, freelance talent, production partners or external marketing suppliers within an agency, in-house agency or consulting environment.

  • Proven ability to evaluate work requirements and recommend the appropriate delivery model, including internal teams, agency partners, contractors or blended teams.

  • Experience balancing competing priorities, shifting business demands and resource constraints in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative, digital, content, production and campaign-delivery workflows.

  • Experience with agency onboarding, scopes of work, estimates, rate structures, retainers, performance reviews and partner governance.

  • Experience maintaining visibility across project demand, resource capacity, utilization, pipeline forecasts and staffing requirements.

  • Strong financial and analytical acumen, including interpreting estimates, staffing models, agency rates, utilization, retainers, project budgets and spend.

  • Experience managing or supporting a centralized network of creative, digital, production, media or marketing agency partners.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • ​Proficiency with project, resource management and workflow platforms, including Workfront or similar enterprise tools.

  • Experience leveraging reporting, AI-enabled planning tools, dashboards and workflow automation to improve forecasting, resource planning and operational visibility.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Experience supporting global or regional agency networks is preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify capacity risks, capability gaps and operational constraints and recommend solutions to address them.

  • Experience partnering with Procurement, Finance, Operations and project leadership teams to support supplier management and operational decision-making.

Work Location: Remote

Travel :May include up to 10% domestic travel.

Supporting Your Well-being

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life, both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

JOB SUMMARY

This role within the marketing & experience department will be at the forefront of blending technology, process, and people to scale our marketing efforts and foster a collaborative and inclusive culture. With a strong emphasis on technology, particularly the widespread adoption and integration of AI, the role demands a high-energy and highly accountable individual who can advance our marketing technology (MarTech) stack in collaboration with other key stakeholder departments. This role will report directly to the Director of MarTech and Operations and lead day-to-day optimization, automation and outsourcing of operational processes across the department. This role will be responsible for managing our MarTech ecosystem, including management and delivery of agreed upon road maps and platform integrations to meet current and future needs. jobs.description:
Job Title:

Sr. Marketing Manager, AI Data Services & Trust & Safety Practice

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Concentrix is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Marketing Manager to lead marketing for our global AI Data Services & Trust & Safety Practice.

This role will be responsible for developing and executing the Practice marketing strategy, building awareness of our capabilities, engaging priority clients and prospects, supporting Sales and Business Development, and demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline and revenue.

Reporting directly to the GVP of AI Data Services & Trust & Safety, the Marketing Manager will own the Practice marketing budget and work closely with Concentrix Corporate Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, Business Development, Practice leadership and subject-matter experts.

The ideal candidate combines B2B marketing strategy, events, demand generation, content development, thought leadership, social media, account-based marketing and marketing analytics. This is a hands-on role for someone who can develop the strategy, mobilize internal resources, execute programs, and measure their commercial impact.

What you will do in this role

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

Practice Marketing Strategy & Budget

  • Develop and manage the annual and quarterly marketing strategy for the AI Data Services & Trust & Safety Practice, aligned to growth priorities, target accounts and revenue objectives.

  • Translate Practice priorities into integrated marketing campaigns across events, content, social media, demand generation, targeted outreach, sponsorships and sales enablement.

  • Own the Practice marketing budget, including planning, allocation, tracking and recommendations for optimizing spend based on measurable results.

  • Evaluate potential investments across conferences, owned events, associations, lead-generation platforms, sponsored content, paid campaigns, and other marketing channels.

  • Stay current on developments across AI, AI training, data services, AI safety and Trust & Safety to identify emerging marketing opportunities and areas where Concentrix can establish a differentiated point of view.

Events, Demand Generation & Account-Based Marketing

  • Develop and execute marketing strategies for third-party conferences, Concentrix-hosted events, executive roundtables, networking events, webinars, client events and internal sector events.

  • Recommend where the Practice should attend, sponsor, speak, host meetings or create adjacent events based on audience quality and business potential.

  • Build target-account and invitation lists in partnership with Sales and Business Development for Practice-owned events and strategic conferences.

  • Develop compelling invitation campaigns through email, LinkedIn, social media and other targeted outreach to drive attendance from relevant executives and decision-makers.

  • Coordinate event messaging, branding, collateral, speakers, attendee communications, executive meetings and follow-up.

  • Build post-event engagement and nurture programs that convert attendees, registrants and priority prospects into meetings and sales opportunities.

  • Support account-based marketing programs designed to reach multiple stakeholders across priority organizations, including leaders in AI, data, product, engineering, operations, Trust & Safety and other relevant functions.

  • Partner with Concentrix Demand Generation teams to create campaigns that generate and nurture qualified demand for Practice services.

Content, Thought Leadership & Social Media

  • Develop and manage an ongoing content and thought-leadership strategy covering AI Data Services, AI model development and evaluation, AI safety, Trust & Safety and emerging market trends.

  • Write blogs, articles, executive perspectives, newsletters and other content directly, or engage Practice subject-matter experts and other contributors where appropriate.

  • Interview Practice executives and SMEs and translate complex technical or operational topics into clear, compelling market-facing content.

  • Identify opportunities for contributed articles, sponsored content, industry publications, webinars, panels, podcasts and speaking engagements.

  • Build a structured thought-leadership program for Practice leaders, including LinkedIn posts, executive commentary, presentation concepts and market POVs.

  • Own the ongoing content strategy for the Practice's LinkedIn presence, maintaining a consistent weekly and monthly publishing cadence.

  • Create a balanced mix of market insights, thought leadership, event promotion, client outcomes, capabilities, employee expertise and industry commentary.

  • Track social and content performance, including audience growth, engagement, traffic, conversions and resulting commercial opportunities.

Marketing Collateral, Case Studies & Sales Enablement

  • Lead development and maintenance of high-quality internal and external marketing collateral supporting AI Data Services and Trust & Safety.

  • Create capability overviews, one-pagers, presentations, solution briefs, use-case materials, infographics, executive POVs, event materials and other sales-enablement assets.

  • Develop targeted content for specific industries, buyer groups, client challenges and emerging AI use cases.

  • Partner with Sales and Business Development to identify gaps in the materials required to support client conversations and prospect engagement.

  • Establish and manage a pipeline of potential client case studies and proof points.

  • Work with delivery teams and account leaders to identify engagements with measurable outcomes that can be developed into client stories, testimonials or anonymized case studies.

  • Maintain an organized and current repository of Practice marketing and sales assets.

Corporate Marketing & Internal Practice Marketing

  • Serve as the primary marketing liaison between the Practice and Concentrix Corporate Marketing, Demand Generation, Communications and related teams.

  • Ensure Practice priorities are represented within broader Concentrix campaigns and marketing programs.

  • Develop internal communications and enablement materials that help Concentrix sellers and account leaders understand AI Data Services and Trust & Safety capabilities, market opportunities, proof points and available assets.

  • Support internal sector meetings, leadership events and client-attended forums where the Practice has an opportunity to build awareness or generate opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities for broader external visibility through analyst engagement, awards, industry associations, executive networks and relevant media channels.

Marketing Analytics, Pipeline Attribution & ROI

  • Own measurement and reporting for Practice marketing activity and provide clear monthly and quarterly updates to Practice leadership.

  • Establish consistent tracking for events, campaigns, content, social media, memberships, sponsored programs and other marketing investments.

  • Track metrics including target-account engagement, event registrations and attendance, meetings generated, leads, opportunities, pipeline created, pipeline influenced and closed-won revenue.

  • Measure the effectiveness and ROI of individual events, campaigns, platforms and marketing investments.

  • Work with Sales and Business Development to maintain effective lead routing, campaign attribution and follow-up.

  • Use performance data to recommend adjustments to marketing strategy, channel mix and budget allocation.

  • Ensure marketing reporting demonstrates not only activity and engagement, but marketing's contribution to Practice growth.

Your qualifications

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you have:

  • 5+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, ideally within technology, artificial intelligence, professional services, outsourcing, digital services, SaaS or another complex enterprise-services environment.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated B2B marketing strategies.

  • Strong experience with event marketing, demand generation and targeted account engagement.

  • Experience partnering closely with enterprise Sales and Business Development teams.

  • Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex subject matter into compelling executive-level content.

  • Experience developing blogs, thought leadership, case studies, presentations, sales collateral and social-media content.

  • Strong understanding of LinkedIn and B2B social-media marketing.

  • Demonstrated experience measuring campaign performance, marketing attribution, pipeline contribution and return on investment.

  • Experience managing marketing budgets, vendors, agencies, publishers or external partners.

  • Strong project-management skills and ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns, events and deadlines.

  • Comfort working directly with senior executives and subject-matter experts.

  • Ability to operate effectively within a large global organization and influence stakeholders across multiple functions.

  • Strong intellectual curiosity and willingness to rapidly develop expertise in AI Data Services and Trust & Safety.

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing AI, machine learning, data, Trust & Safety, digital platforms or related technology services.

  • Experience marketing complex managed services or outsourcing solutions to large enterprises and technology companies.

  • Experience with account-based marketing, CRM campaign attribution and marketing automation.

  • Experience developing executive thought leadership and supporting external speaking opportunities.

  • Experience managing global marketing programs across the United States, United Kingdom and other international markets.

What Success Looks Like

The successful Marketing Manager will help the Practice:

  • Increase awareness and understanding of Concentrix AI Data Services and Trust & Safety among priority audiences.

  • Build engagement within strategic target accounts.

  • Generate qualified meetings, leads and opportunities through marketing activity.

  • Demonstrate measurable pipeline and revenue contribution from events and campaigns.

  • Improve the return generated from the Practice marketing budget.

  • Establish a consistent and credible thought-leadership presence in the market.

  • Maintain high-quality, current collateral and client proof points that support Sales and Business Development.

  • Provide clear visibility into marketing performance through disciplined monthly and quarterly reporting.

The position will require periodic travel for industry conferences, client events, executive roundtables, Concentrix meetings and other Practice marketing activities.

What’s in it for you

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

  • Full time position

  • Remote working

  • Competitive Salary

Power the best version of you!

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”

Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer

We're proudly united as one team, one company, globally. We're committed to equal employment opportunities for all candidates and a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All our recruitment practices are based on business needs, job requirements, and professional qualifications, without regard to race, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, family or parental status, national origin, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable national laws.

jobs.excerpt: By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful.
jobs.description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

General Liability Adjuster

Primary Purpose

The Commercial General Liability (CGL) Claims Adjuster is responsible for the end-to-end handling of complex third-party bodily injury and property damage claims arising under commercial general liability policies. This role requires advanced expertise in coverage analysis, liability determination, litigation management, and risk transfer, particularly across multi-jurisdictional and construction-related exposures. The adjuster is expected to proactively manage claim outcomes, control loss costs, and ensure compliance with client service standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality expectations.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Claim Investigation & File Ownership

  • Independently investigate and manage a full caseload of CGL claims, including but not limited to premises liability, slip and fall, product liability, construction defect and construction-related losses, and contractual liability exposures.

  • Drive timely claim resolution through proactive file management, strategic planning, and adherence to best practices in diary management and documentation.

  • Coverage Analysis & Policy Interpretation

  • Analyze complex policy language, including insuring agreements, endorsements, exclusions (e.g., ongoing/completed operations, additional insured provisions), and limits to determine coverage applicability.

  • Draft clear, defensible coverage position letters, including reservation of rights and denial letters, consistent with jurisdictional requirements and client expectations.

  • Liability & Damages Evaluation

  • Conduct comprehensive liability investigations, including:

  • Review and analysis of incident reports, contracts, lease agreements, and indemnification provisions

  • Identification and application of contractual risk transfer provisions

  • Obtaining and evaluating recorded statements, expert opinions, photographs, and surveillance

  • Evaluate injury severity, medical treatment, and long-term exposure, including review of medical records, bills, and independent medical evaluations (IMEs) where applicable.

We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.

The Principal ASIC Verification Engineer serves as a technical authority for verification of advanced ASICs enabling next-generation Satellite communication systems. This role sets verification strategy across one or more silicon programs and ensures robust methodologies for functionally complex, high-performance communication hardware.

Responsibilities:

  • Define end-to-end verification strategy for large Satellite communication ASIC or SoC programs.
  • Establish verification methodologies, infrastructure, and signoff criteria across block, subsystem, and SoC levels.
  • Lead verification planning for complex communication functions such as modem pipelines, FEC engines, digital beamforming, packet processing, and control fabrics.
  • Drive alignment among design, architecture, systems, firmware, and validation teams.
  • Evaluate verification completeness through coverage, assertions, formal analysis, emulation, and silicon correlation.
  • Resolve critical technical issues and direct root-cause analysis for the most complex functional failures.
  • Guide development of reusable VIP, reference models, and regression automation frameworks.
  • Mentor technical leaders and raise the overall verification maturity of the organization.
  • Influence future verification roadmap, tool strategy, and reuse models.

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 12+ years of ASIC/SoC verification experience.
  • Expert-level knowledge of System Verilog, UVM, assertions, and verification signoff methodology.
  • Proven success leading verification for complex chips or multiple tape-outs.
  • Strong understanding of communication signal-processing hardware and system-level integration.
  • Excellent technical leadership and cross-organizational communication skills.

  • Deep expertise in Space based communications, digital modems, phased-array processing, or payload processing.

  • Assist in reviewing fire protection hydraulic calculations, fire pump analyses, water supply evaluations, and system acceptance testing requirements.
  • Assist in reviewing fire alarm system architectures, battery calculations, sequence of operations, cause-and-effect matrices, and integrated testing plans.
  • Support factory witness testing, site acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Coordinate with AHJs, insurance representatives, consultants, contractors, and commissioning teams to support project approvals and occupancy milestones.

  • Basic experience with fire protection, fire alarm, life safety, construction, commissioning, facility operations, or engineering design.
  • Familiarity with engineering drawings, specifications, submittals, and construction documents.
  • Understanding of fire suppression systems, fire alarm systems, smoke detection systems, and life safety systems.

  • Experience designing, supporting, or reviewing fire protection and fire alarm systems for data centers, mission-critical facilities, industrial facilities, or large commercial developments.
  • Assist with project management responsibilities across multiple projects and campuses.
  • Experience with fire alarm sequence of operations, cause-and-effect matrices, system testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Direct experience in the construction of data centers, critical medical facilities, industrial facilities, or other mission-critical environments.
  • Basic knowledge of NFPA standards, including but not limited to NFPA 13, NFPA 20, NFPA 24, NFPA 72, NFPA 75, NFPA 76, NFPA 101, and NFPA 4, as well as applicable building and fire codes.
  • Familiarity with FM Global Data Sheets, insurance requirements, and loss prevention strategies.
  • Experience with double-interlock pre-action sprinkler systems, clean agent systems, water-based suppression systems, and special hazard protection systems.
  • Experience with VESDA and aspirating smoke detection systems, very early warning fire detection systems, and integration with monitoring and control platforms.
  • Experience supporting integrated systems testing, acceptance testing, and commissioning of fire protection and life safety systems.
  • Experience evaluating performance-based fire protection alternatives and alternative means and methods.
  • Basic knowledge of fire protection, fire alarm, and life safety systems and their integration into mission-critical environments.
  • Basic multidisciplinary knowledge of electrical, mechanical, controls, commissioning, pre-construction requirements, and construction processes.
  • Ability to communicate technical issues to senior leadership, consultants, contractors, AHJs, insurers, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • NICET certification, EIT certification, CFPS certification, or a desire to pursue industry certifications is preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of fire protection, fire alarm, life safety, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Ability to review, interpret, and communicate engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and testing requirements.
  • Understanding of risk management principles and fire protection strategies for mission-critical facilities.
  • Ability to balance code compliance, operational reliability, maintainability, and project requirements when evaluating technical solutions.
