jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Sweden

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Sweden. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we believe reliable communication and thoughtful problem-solving are important parts of a good software experience. We value people who take ownership, pay attention to details, communicate clearly, and understand how to coordinate with the right teams when an issue requires specialized assistance.

About the Role

We're looking for a Patient Services Specialist to support non-clinical patient service requests, coordinate administrative follow-ups, and help resolve more complex issues within Bask Health's telehealth platform.

This position is intended for someone with experience handling customer or patient concerns, managing service cases, and communicating clearly across multiple teams.

You'll help patients navigate supported software workflows, understand approved next steps, and receive appropriate assistance when an issue cannot be resolved through routine support procedures.

You'll take ownership of assigned service cases and coordinate with the appropriate teams until each matter is resolved or properly transferred.

Bask Health provides software that helps entrepreneurs, online businesses, and healthcare organizations launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

Our platform brings together patient-facing experiences, merchant storefronts, questionnaires, checkout workflows, clinical processes, and pharmacy-related operations.

You'll develop a practical understanding of the non-clinical platform workflows relevant to your assigned responsibilities.

You'll assist with patient questions involving supported account, navigation, and administrative processes.

You'll provide approved guidance for completing non-clinical steps within the platform.

You'll help investigate issues that cannot be resolved through basic troubleshooting.

You'll gather relevant information to understand the nature of a reported problem.

You'll review available support records and prior communications when authorized.

You'll identify what actions have already been taken and what additional follow-up is needed.

You'll maintain accurate case notes and ensure important details are documented.

You'll manage assigned service cases through approved ticketing or case management systems.

You'll organize open requests according to established priorities and escalation procedures.

You'll help ensure unresolved cases have clear ownership and documented next steps.

You'll follow through on administrative requests that require coordination across multiple teams.

You'll communicate with patients through approved channels, which may include email, chat, or other designated systems.

You'll explain information clearly and avoid unnecessary technical or medical terminology.

You'll remain professional when handling sensitive, confusing, or frustrating situations.

You'll help patients understand what can be addressed through the support team and what requires assistance from another authorized party.

You'll communicate approved updates when a service case remains unresolved.

You'll avoid promising outcomes or resolution timelines that have not been confirmed.

You'll identify situations where a patient's concern involves multiple operational or technical issues.

You'll coordinate with the appropriate teams to clarify responsibilities and next steps.

You'll help prevent patients from being repeatedly transferred between teams without a clear reason.

You'll recognize when a request belongs to a merchant, licensed healthcare provider, pharmacy, or another authorized organization.

You'll follow established ownership boundaries when directing requests.

You'll work with merchant success or customer support teams when an issue involves a merchant-controlled workflow.

You'll collaborate with technical support and engineering teams when software functionality requires investigation.

You'll document technical symptoms, affected workflows, and troubleshooting steps accurately.

You'll help ensure technical teams receive sufficient information to investigate reported problems.

You'll track the progress of escalated cases and maintain appropriate follow-up.

You'll recognize when a question involves a diagnosis, treatment recommendation, prescription decision, or other clinical matter.

You'll refer clinical questions to the appropriate licensed or authorized healthcare professional.

You'll recognize when a request involves medication preparation, dispensing, fulfillment, or other pharmacy-specific activities.

You'll direct those matters to the appropriate pharmacy or authorized support contact.

You'll never provide medical advice, interpret clinical information, recommend medications, or make treatment decisions.

You'll avoid making statements about whether a patient will qualify for or be approved for treatment.

You'll avoid guaranteeing medication availability, prescription fulfillment, or delivery outcomes.

You'll follow approved privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.

You'll use established identity verification practices before discussing account-specific information.

You'll access only the information necessary and authorized for your assigned responsibilities.

You'll use approved systems when documenting or communicating sensitive information.

You'll recognize and report suspected privacy or security concerns.

You'll help identify recurring patient service issues that may indicate broader platform or process problems.

You'll document patterns in reported concerns and share them with the appropriate internal teams.

You'll contribute suggestions for improving patient-facing instructions and support procedures.

You'll help maintain accurate internal knowledge articles, case resolution guides, and escalation documentation.

You'll participate in training on new platform features and changes to approved support processes.

You'll help identify outdated or confusing support instructions.

You'll provide feedback on common questions that could be addressed through clearer guidance or improved software design.

You'll collaborate with customer support leadership to improve service consistency and case resolution practices.

You'll help identify administrative handoffs that create unnecessary delays.

You'll support improvements to case tracking, documentation, and escalation processes.

You'll contribute to reports or summaries of recurring service issues when requested.

You'll help monitor relevant indicators such as case status, follow-up completion, recurring issues, and service quality.

You'll use support data and customer feedback to recommend practical improvements.

You'll manage multiple cases while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

You'll prioritize work according to approved guidelines and established escalation requirements.

You'll communicate proactively when a case is blocked or requires additional assistance.

You'll ask for guidance when a request falls outside your authority or established procedures.

You'll remain organized when coordinating with several teams or handling multiple unresolved requests.

You'll take responsibility for completing assigned follow-ups and documenting outcomes.

You'll support consistent communication between patient-facing support and internal operational teams.

You'll help ensure cases are appropriately resolved, escalated, or transferred rather than left without ownership.

You'll be comfortable learning new software tools and adapting to changing platform workflows.

You'll contribute to a team environment that values accountability, accuracy, clear communication, and continuous improvement.

We're looking for someone with experience in patient services, customer support, healthcare administration, or another customer-facing service environment.

You should be comfortable handling more involved support cases, organizing information, coordinating with multiple teams, and following detailed procedures.

Healthcare or telehealth experience would be helpful, but this is a non-clinical position and does not involve providing medical care.

Success in this role means resolving non-clinical service issues accurately, maintaining clear case documentation, coordinating effective handoffs, and ensuring patients receive reliable communication and appropriate assistance.

What You'll Do

  • Manage assigned non-clinical patient service cases.

  • Assist with supported account, navigation, and administrative workflows.
  • Investigate issues that require more than basic troubleshooting.

Requirements

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our team at Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), is united by a commitment to collaboration and scientific excellence, building on a strong foundation of innovation, expertise, and reliability. Guided by our vision to help researchers rapidly move from the lab to life-changing advances, we work closely with global partners to accelerate progress and genomics breakthroughs across fields like cancer, infectious disease, rare genetic disorders, and more. At IDT, you’ll be part of a culture rooted in continuous learning and improvement—where your growth fuels our mission to accelerate the pace of genomics and helps shape a healthier, brighter future for all.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Commercial Product Manager, NGS Segments is responsible for driving commercial strategy and sustainable growth across the NGS portfolio, with a particular focus on the Clinical, Pharma, and Biopharma customer segments. This role combines customer insights, competitive intelligence, market opportunity analysis, and portfolio strategy to identify growth opportunities and guide commercialization priorities.

Working with key stakeholders including Sales, R&D, Applications Development, and Marketing, the Senior Commercial Product Manager will translate technical capabilities and market intelligence into differentiated positioning, customer-focused messaging, and integrated go-to-market strategies to increase adoption, strengthen competitive differentiation, and deliver revenue and margin growth. This position is part of the NGS Business Unit in Boulder, CO, and can be remote or on-site.

  • Identify and prioritize growth opportunities across key customer segments by understanding workflows, unmet needs, purchasing criteria, scientific applications, and business challenges.
  • Use voice-of-customer insights, competitive intelligence, market trends, and sales data to shape portfolio strategy and commercialization priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to solve complex commercial challenges, develop segmentation and targeting strategies, and identify innovative growth opportunities.
  • Develop sales tools, training, customer-facing content, and commercial programs, while effectively communicating recommendations and influencing stakeholders to support execution.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3+ years of experience in Next Generation Sequencing product management, strategic marketing, commercial experience, or other relevant technical environment
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20% domestically and internationally

  • Demonstrated success developing portfolio strategies, commercial growth plans, product positioning, and go-to-market programs.

It would be a plus if you also possess:

  • PhD in biological sciences (biology, chemistry, biochemistry) or a related field
  • Demonstrated understanding of competitors, technologies, trends, and key challenges in NGS, Pharma, Clinical, and Oncology research markets.

jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Luxembourg

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Luxembourg. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, Billing & Revenue Systems to help build and maintain the backend services supporting payments, subscriptions, billing workflows, and revenue-related functionality across Bask Health's telehealth platform.

You'll develop APIs, application logic, and integrations that connect patient checkout, merchant billing configuration, subscription management, and payment processing.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with experience building production backend applications and working with transactional data. You'll implement meaningful features, investigate billing issues, and help improve the accuracy and reliability of systems used by merchants, patients, and internal teams.

Our backend stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, finance, and operations teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.

We're looking for someone who pays attention to details, understands the importance of data accuracy, and enjoys solving backend problems that directly affect real transactions and customer experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend services supporting payments, subscriptions, billing, and revenue-related workflows.
  • Develop APIs and application logic for subscription creation, renewals, cancellations, payment status updates, and billing changes.
  • Implement backend features using TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases.
  • Build and maintain integrations with payment processors and third-party billing services.
  • Work with payment events, webhooks, and asynchronous processing to keep billing records up to date.
  • Help implement pricing rules, discounts, trials, and billing configuration across merchant and patient workflows.
  • Create and maintain database models for transactions, subscriptions, invoices, and billing events.
  • Implement validation, error handling, retries, and safeguards against duplicate transaction processing.
  • Work with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge to support background jobs and event-driven workflows.
  • Help investigate discrepancies between internal billing records and external payment systems.
  • Build automated tests for billing logic, subscription changes, payment failures, and common edge cases.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, investigate failed payments or unexpected billing behavior, and help implement lasting fixes.
  • Improve logging, monitoring, and visibility into billing system performance.
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to understand recurring billing issues and reporting needs.
  • Work with product managers and senior engineers to break requirements into technical implementation tasks.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and engineering discussions.
  • Follow secure development practices when handling payment-related and sensitive customer information.
  • Contribute to internal tools that help teams investigate transactions and resolve billing issues.
  • Document APIs, billing workflows, and important system behavior.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to support development, debugging, and testing while reviewing generated code carefully.
  • Take ownership of assigned features from implementation through testing, deployment, and follow-up.
  • Help improve existing billing services and contribute ideas for making transaction processing more reliable and maintainable.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on backend development.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.
  • Experience building, testing, and maintaining production backend applications and APIs.
  • Experience working with SQL databases, relational data models, and database schema design.
  • Practical experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs, processing webhooks, or implementing asynchronous backend workflows.
  • Understanding of transactional data integrity, error handling, and reliable data processing.
  • Familiarity with serverless applications, background jobs, or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience using modern database access tools or ORMs.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive information.
  • Ability to implement backend features involving complex business rules and state changes.
  • Experience writing automated tests and debugging production applications.
  • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, and modern software development workflows.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and communicate findings clearly.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools while independently reviewing and validating generated code.
  • Ability to complete assigned features independently and collaborate with senior engineers on more complex projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, particularly when working with transactional data.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where engineers take ownership of their work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building payment processing, billing, or subscription management systems.
  • Experience integrating Stripe or comparable payment processors.
  • Familiarity with recurring billing, subscription renewals, cancellations, refunds, or failed-payment recovery.
  • Experience implementing idempotency, webhook processing, retries, or transaction reconciliation.
  • Familiarity with pricing engines, discounts, trials, or subscription plan management.
  • Experience with SST and AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge.
  • Experience with Prisma, Drizzle, or tRPC.
  • Familiarity with Next.js, React, or full-stack TypeScript development.
  • Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS applications or monorepo architectures.
  • Experience building e-commerce checkout flows, merchant billing tools, or paid SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS considerations or payment-related security practices.

  • Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools.

jobs.excerpt: JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.  Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients.
jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

The Opportunity


The Global Compliance & Risk Lead owns compliance and risk management across every program and business line on the Intel account, ensuring JLL and its people operate to the highest ethical and regulatory standard everywhere the account does business. This is not a single-domain compliance role: it spans contractual, regulatory, data, and operational compliance and enterprise risk management across IFM REWS and SPGC alike, with a particular and deliberate emphasis on developing the on account self-audit program, ethics and conflict of interest — protecting the integrity of the client relationship and the individuals who deliver it.


Reporting to the Intel Global Finance Director, with a dotted line into JLL's Technical, Risk & HSSE Director, this role is the senior point of accountability for compliance & Risk on the account: setting the global framework, running the account's ethics and conflict-of-interest programs, and partnering with every account leader — from the Global HSSEQ Director to the Regional Account Directors — to ensure compliance is built into how the account operates, not bolted on after the fact.


Primary Responsibilities


Global Compliance Strategy & Framework


  • Own and evolve a single global compliance and risk framework for the Intel account, covering all programs, business lines, and regions (AMR/LATAM, EMEA, APAC).
  • Translate JLL's corporate compliance policy and the client's own compliance requirements into a coherent, account-specific compliance and risk management program.
  • Ensure compliance standards are applied consistently across IFM REWS and SPGC, and across every regional and functional team on the account.
  • Identify and prioritize the account's key compliance risk areas and set the annual global compliance and riskplan, audit and sampling calendar.
  • Ensure the compliance and risk program is understood by regional JLL teams, and that risk and compliance training is delivered in every region, alongside the ethics and conflict-of-interest curriculum.

Ethics & Conflict of Interest


  • Design, own, and continuously improve the account's ethics and conflict-of-interest program, including disclosure processes, review protocols, and escalation pathways.
  • Act as the senior point of contact for conflict-of-interest declarations and reviews across the account, including those involving vendors, subcontractors, and third parties.
  • Partner with Legal and JLL's Global Ethics & Compliance function on the investigation and resolution of ethics concerns raised on the account.
  • Build and deliver an ethics and conflict-of-interest training curriculum for account leadership, site teams, and project teams globally.
  • Monitor for emerging conflict-of-interest risk as the account grows, including new vendor relationships, subcontracting arrangements, and cross-account staffing.

Program & Contractual Compliance


  • Ensure compliance requirements are built into every program on the account, from day-to-day IFM REWS operations through to SPGC capital projects.
  • Monitor adherence to contractual compliance obligations owed to the client, and to statutory and regulatory requirements in every operating jurisdiction.
  • Partner with the Global HSSEQ Director, Global Talent Acquisition Lead, and Global Director of Digital & Transformation to ensure compliance considerations are reflected in HSSEQ, hiring, and digital/data practices.
  • Own compliance input into vendor and subcontractor accreditation processes across the account.
  • Oversee implementation of the client's contract governance, and information and data security risk programs, in conjunction with Operations and Sourcing teams.
  • Implement and ensure compliance with the anti-bribery and anti-corruption program in every region.

Enterprise Risk & Incident Management


  • Develop, document and run the account Enterprise Risk Assessment program, and oversee implementation of risk mitigation initiatives, with outputs captured in the global risk register.
  • Develop and implement the account incident escalation program in support of the client's business continuity plans (BCPs) in each region, with routine testing, documentation and reporting.
  • Participate in the resolution of high-level risk events, including legal and insurance claims and investigations: identify root cause, report objectively, and liaise with the client and subcontractors affected.

Monitoring, Audit & Reporting


  • Design and run a global compliance audit and sampling program, including scheduled and ad hoc reviews across regions, countries, sites and programs.
  • Track and drive resolution of corrective actions and delivery improvements arising from compliance audits, findings and investigations, working with the affected managers and sites, through to closure.
  • Support engagement with client auditors (internal and external) and JLL auditors (internal and external).
  • Consolidate regional and program-level compliance data into a single global compliance and risk report, including trends, changes in standards (internal and external) and performance against them, for account and JLL leadership.
  • Maintain a global register of compliance and enterprise risks, incidents, and conflict-of-interest cases, with clear ownership and status tracking.

Governance & Stakeholder Engagement


  • Chair a global compliance and risk governance forum bringing together compliance contacts from each region and program.
  • Appoint and support Risk Champions across regions and programs, ensuring the roles are identified and filled.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for compliance concerns raised by any employee, vendor, or client stakeholder on the account.
  • Represent compliance in Account Global Leadership Team discussions, ensuring compliance risk is visible in strategic decision-making.
  • Foster a positive, proactive and business-focused culture in which raising compliance and ethics concerns is safe, expected, and acted upon promptly.
  • Meet regularly with the client and key regional JLL leaders in each area of responsibility.
  • Manage and support special projects across the account as required.

Key Performance Measures


  • Completion of the global compliance audit and sampling plan and closure of corrective actions within agreed timelines.
  • Timeliness and quality of conflict-of-interest disclosures, reviews, and resolutions across the account.
  • Training completion rates for ethics and conflict-of-interest programs across all regions.
  • Reduction in repeat or unresolved compliance findings across programs and regions.
  • Stakeholder confidence in the compliance function, including client and JLL leadership feedback.
  • Consistency of the global compliance and risk report and risk register across all programs.
  • Regional results in client and JLL audits and reviews, and Risk Champion roles identified and filled.
  • Incident escalation program in place, tested and documented, and risk mitigation actions delivered on time.
  • Personal objectives met as agreed in JLL's Individual Performance Management process.

Attributes


  • Unimpeachable personal integrity and sound ethical judgement, comfortable making and defending difficult calls.
  • Strong influencing, persuasion and negotiation skills, able to hold account and regional leadership accountable to compliance standards without direct authority over them, and credible with both senior leaders and site facility and engineering managers.
  • Discreet and trustworthy, able to handle sensitive ethics and conflict-of-interest matters with appropriate confidentiality.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, able to spot patterns and emerging risk across large volumes of program and regional data, and to use data and technology solutions to drive decisions.
  • Calm under pressure, able to manage investigations and escalations without losing objectivity.
  • Comfortable operating across a large, matrixed, multi-regional and multi-cultural organization with varying local regulatory contexts.
  • Pragmatic, cost-effective approach to risk and compliance; strong problem solver who develops effective, easy-to-use processes.
  • Self-motivated, able to work independently and remotely.

Requirements


  • Significant experience (minimum 5 years in management) in compliance, ethics, risk, or internal audit leadership role, working with corporate clients, ideally spanning multiple regions.
  • Experience advising senior management at policy level, and investigating incidents, identifying root cause and reporting objectively, in a dynamic, diverse environment.
  • Change management experience.
  • Direct experience designing or running conflict-of-interest and ethics programs, including disclosure and investigation processes.
  • Experience operating in a multi-service-line environment (e.g. facilities management, construction, or professional services) and an understanding of related processes and systems is a strong advantage.
  • Working knowledge of all relevant compliance, anti-bribery/corruption, and data protection regulation across multiple jurisdictions, and acting as the account champion in these areas.
  • Membership of JLL’s internal governance bodies, i.e. Ethics Liaisons, Data Privacy Champions, HSSE, Quality Forums, etc.
  • Experience partnering with Legal and corporate Ethics & Compliance functions in a large, global organization.
  • Bachelor's degree required, ideally in Quality, Risk or Legal fields; Lead Auditor qualification or experience; relevant compliance or ethics certification (e.g. CCEP, CFE) is a distinct advantage.
  • Membership of the International Register of Certified Auditors (IRCA) or national equivalent, and knowledge of Quality and Risk Management standards (e.g. ISO 9001, ISO 31000), are desirable.
  • Willingness to travel across AMR/LATAM, EMEA, and APAC as required.

jobs.description:
Covetrus is a global animal-health technology and services leader dedicated to empowering veterinary practice partners to drive improved health and financial outcomes. We bring together products, services, and technology into a single platform that connects our customers to the solutions and insights they need to work best. Our passion for the well-being of animals and those who care for them drives us to advance the world of veterinary medicine.

Managing DIrector, Calibra Pet Nutritition

Location: Remote-based, with regular travel to Brno, Czech Republic

The opportunity


Calibra is entering an important new stage of its growth.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Managing Director to lead the business, strengthen its position and take the brand into new markets, channels and customer segments.


This is a true business leadership role with full P&L accountability. You will own the strategy, financial performance and future direction of Calibra, balancing ambitious growth with strong commercial discipline and operational delivery. You will also be part of the Executive Leadership Team, working collaboratively across the wider Covetrus organisation.


The opportunity goes well beyond growing through existing Covetrus relationships. A core priority will be expanding Calibra’s presence across specialist retail, e-commerce, marketplaces and selected external distribution partnerships, while protecting the credibility and positioning of the brand.


What you will lead

You will:

  • Own and execute the Calibra business strategy, creating a prioritised European expansion plan supported by clear market-level business cases.
  • Take full responsibility for revenue, gross margin, profitability and EBITDA growth.
  • Identify where Calibra can win and make commercially disciplined decisions about the markets, channels and partnerships worth pursuing.
  • Build the retail and e-commerce strategy, including marketplaces, retailer platforms and direct-to-consumer opportunities where commercially viable.
  • Develop the right pricing, margin, trade-term and channel models to support profitable growth without undermining existing veterinary and Covetrus channels.
  • Strengthen brand awareness and preference among both pet owners and pet professionals.
  • Shape the product portfolio and innovation pipeline in partnership with Product Development and Quality.
  • Ensure Manufacturing, Quality and Customer Service can support growth reliably, efficiently and at the right cost.
  • Use data, market insight and AI-enabled technology to accelerate marketing, product development and decision-making.
  • Lead, develop and strengthen a multidisciplinary team across commercial, marketing, operations, production, customer service, project management, product development and quality.
  • Contribute actively to the Executive Leadership Team, providing clear forecasts, transparent reporting.

What success will look like

You will:


  • Established a clear growth strategy and agreed the priority market sequence and supporting business cases.
  • Defined the retail and e-commerce strategy, selected priority partners and launched the first new retail and online channels.
  • Delivered against revenue, gross margin and EBITDA commitments, with a credible path to sustainable year-on-year growth.

What you will bring


We are looking for a commercially sharp and entrepreneurial leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution.


You will bring:

  • At least 10 years of senior leadership experience, including full P&L responsibility.
  • Strong experience within the animal health industry.
  • A proven record of expanding a business or brand into new international markets.
  • Direct experience of growing brand sales through retail and e-commerce, not solely through owned or group distribution channels.
  • International leadership experience, including responsibility for geographically dispersed teams.
  • Confidence operating within a complex matrix organisation.
  • Experience building investment cases and presenting recommendations for senior approval.

Experience within pet food manufacturing, whether directly operated or outsourced, would be advantageous. Czech language capability would also be beneficial but is not essential.


You will combine:

  • Commercial judgement: The ability to identify where Calibra can genuinely win and focus investment on the opportunities that matter.

Your Opportunity as the Manager, Responsible Sourcing Program

Help shape and lead Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing Program, supporting the prevention and mitigation of social compliance and human rights risks across our global supply chains. Guide program strategy and governance, lead human rights due diligence and risk-management activities, engage suppliers, build strategic partnerships, and support public reporting and external communications. Work across the organization and with key external stakeholders to translate complex human rights considerations, evolving regulations, and social compliance standards into practical actions that protect people, strengthen our supply chain, and support Smucker’s commitments.


Location: Working Remote U.S.


Work Arrangements: Remote with 15% annual travel, ability to work with colleagues on eastern standard time.


In this role you will:


Responsible Sourcing Strategy and Governance

  • Guide Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing strategy, program priorities, governance, and decision-making practices.
  • Lead the development and ongoing maintenance of Smucker’s Supplier Code and related standards, expectations, and guidance.
  • Interpret human rights and social compliance frameworks and translate them into practical expectations for suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor evolving regulations, standards, and emerging human rights issues, coordinating cross-functional input and recommending appropriate program changes.

Human Rights Due Diligence and Risk Management

  • Assess human rights and Responsible Sourcing risks using regulatory information, supplier data, Sedex, audit findings, and other available sources.
  • Recommend and coordinate appropriate due diligence, preventive, corrective, remediation, and risk-mitigation actions.
  • Evaluate and escalate significant social compliance and human rights concerns based on severity and potential business impact.
  • Partner with suppliers and internal stakeholders to monitor corrective actions and remediation, escalating issues or recommending additional action when needed.
  • Apply sound judgment to determine when Responsible Sourcing should lead, support, engage another function, or escalate an issue.

Supplier Engagement, Internal Support, and Partnerships

  • Engage suppliers to communicate Responsible Sourcing expectations, address identified risks, and support education and capability building.
  • Provide Responsible Sourcing expertise and practical guidance to Strategic Business Areas, including Green Coffee, and other internal teams.
  • Develop and deliver training and awareness materials tailored to relevant audiences and business needs.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sustainability, Ethics and Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, Procurement, International Trade Compliance, and business teams on Responsible Sourcing and human rights matters.
  • Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers, industry groups, investors, nongovernmental organizations, and other external partners.
  • Represent Smucker in relevant industry collaborations and initiatives, including the Seafood Task Force and Tuna Responsible Business Alliance Program activities.

Public Reporting and External Communications

  • Lead or support Responsible Sourcing reporting, assessments, and disclosures, including EcoVadis, Walmart Project Gigaton, the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil, and other applicable programs.
  • Coordinate Responsible Sourcing information and supporting evidence for leadership updates, regulatory disclosures, corporate reporting, and investor inquiries.
  • Maintain Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing microsite in partnership with Corporate Communications.
  • Support key corporate disclosures, including the California Transparency in Supply Chains Act disclosure, annual Corporate Impact Report, and Canada’s annual supply chain reporting requirements.

KnowTheChain Benchmark

  • Own Smucker’s end-to-end KnowTheChain benchmark process, conducted every other year.
  • Monitor methodology changes and assess implications for Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing Program and disclosures.
  • Manage relationships and communication with the KnowTheChain team throughout the benchmark process.
  • Coordinate the Additional Disclosure, including gathering required information and supporting evidence from internal stakeholders and ensuring timely submission.
  • Evaluate benchmark results and feedback to identify opportunities to strengthen Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing Program.

What we are looking for:

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field
  • 5+ years of experience across at least two areas such as responsible sourcing, human rights or social compliance, sustainability, legal or regulatory compliance, human resources, or supply chain/procurement.
  • 5+ years of experience assessing human rights, social compliance, supplier, or supply chain risks and recommending appropriate actions.
  • Experience engaging suppliers and partnering across functions to address complex issues and influence outcomes.
  • Ability to interpret standards, policies, regulations, and external frameworks and translate them into practical business actions.
  • Working knowledge of Sedex and SMETA 7.0, including social compliance due diligence, audit findings, and corrective-action follow-up.
  • Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to evaluate complex or incomplete information, navigate ambiguity, and determine an appropriate path forward.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex topics for leaders, internal stakeholders, suppliers, and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines based on risk and business impact.
  • Flexibility to occasionally adjust working hours to effectively engage with international suppliers and partners.

Additional skills and experience that we think would make someone successful in this role

  • Experience leading or supporting a Responsible Sourcing or human rights due diligence program, including supplier corrective action or remediation.

jobs.description:
Remote · Part-time (4–6 hours/day) · Pacific Time, 9:00 AM–2:00 PM

About the role

Our client is a vacation rental business that needs a detail-oriented, tech-savvy bookkeeper to keep their books accurate and up to date. You'll own the day-to-day accounting, from reconciliations to owner payouts, and work directly with the owner, with support from an external accountant and a CPA at tax time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership, catches small details before they become problems, and looks for ways to work faster and with fewer errors, using integrations, copy-paste and automation instead of manual data entry.

Requirements

  • Manage the daily bookkeeping in QuickBooks, including transactions coming in from booking platform integrations.
  • Complete bank and account reconciliations accurately and on time.
  • Prepare owner payouts each month, which is the busiest week of the month.
  • Maintain the balance sheet and track the P&L so the owner always has a clear view of the business.
  • Support the CPA with tax preparation, organizing documents and records.
  • Check in daily and send an end-of-day report with what was completed, what's pending and any issues.
  • Spot errors and inconsistencies early and propose better ways to keep the books clean.

What success looks like

  • First month: You've taken ownership of the day-to-day books, you catch the small details, and the owner can trust your accounting work.
  • By month 3: Owner payouts and reconciliations are completed on time, and the balance sheet and P&L are up to date.
  • By month 6: You're supporting the CPA with tax preparation.
  • Tools you will use
    • QuickBooks: primary accounting tool, with integrations from booking platforms
    • Property management system
    • Google Sheets and Google Drive
    • Slack and WhatsApp: daily communication
  • Who you are
    • Experienced bookkeeper or accountant: solid accounting knowledge and hands-on experience with reconciliations, balance sheets and P&L.
    • QuickBooks proficient: comfortable working in QuickBooks every day, including bank feeds and integrations.
    • Strong in spreadsheets: confident with Google Sheets for tracking, reconciling and reporting.
    • Tech-savvy and accurate: you avoid manual entry errors by using integrations, copy-paste and smart workflows.
    • Proactive and self-directed: you take ownership, flag issues before you're asked, and keep the owner informed.
    • Clear communicator: strong written and spoken English, and comfortable sending concise daily updates.
    • Available on Pacific Time from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
  • Strong plus: US tax experience.
  • Nice to have: accounting experience in real estate, vacation rentals (Airbnb, VRBO) or hotels, including owner payouts.
  • Schedule
    • Part-time, 4–6 hours per day, tentatively 9:00 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time.
    • Steady workload, with one busier week each month during owner payout preparation.
    • Part-time in the long term, with openness to revisit hours as the business grows.

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Weekly pay

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, Pharmacy Integrations to help build and maintain the backend systems connecting Bask Health's telehealth platform with pharmacy partners and fulfillment operations.

You'll develop APIs, backend services, and integration workflows that support prescription routing, pharmacy orders, fulfillment updates, and the exchange of information between Bask and external systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with experience building production backend applications and integrating third-party services. You'll work on meaningful features, troubleshoot integration issues, and help improve the reliability of systems used by our pharmacy operations teams.

Our backend stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with tools such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, and pharmacy operations teams to turn operational requirements into reliable technical solutions.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving integration challenges, pays attention to data accuracy, and takes responsibility for the quality of their work.

What You'll Do

  • Take ownership of assigned features from development through testing, deployment, and follow-up.

Requirements

  • Experience building, testing, and maintaining production backend applications and APIs.

Nice to Have

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.excerpt: About Acoustic At Acoustic, we believe people can feel when a brand is paying attention.
jobs.description:
About Acoustic

At Acoustic, we believe people can feel when a brand is paying attention. Our customer engagement platform helps B2C marketers put that belief into practice by bringing customer behavior, product insights, campaign context, and messaging tools like email, SMS, WhatsApp, and mobile push together in one place. This helps busy marketers understand what deserves their attention now and act while it still matters.

Our audience knows marketing. They recognize a good idea, notice the details, and have seen plenty of software companies make the same promises. That gives us a creative challenge worth taking on: tell Acoustic’s story clearly and distinctively, with copy and visuals that reflect the people, decisions, and everyday realities behind the work.

About the role

You notice when a typeface changes the mood or an unexpected image makes an idea click. You’ve rewatched a video just to figure out how they pulled off that transition. As our Senior Brand Designer, you’ll put those instincts to work for an audience of marketers who know good work when they see it and expect us to make some.

We rebranded this year and now comes the fun part: discovering everything our brand can do. We want to push the boundaries of B2B marketing with work our audience looks forward to seeing. You’ll have real room to shape how we get there. Motion graphics and video will be central to your work, along with design for our website, campaigns, social media, and events.

You’ll report to the Director of Brand & Content, who owns brand strategy and creative direction. As a close creative partner, you’ll turn that direction into design: pitching ideas, adapting our visual identity for new formats and channels, and taking projects from concept through production. Bring your opinions. We want to hear them.

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States. A portfolio is required: show us work that makes you proud, including motion and video, and tell us which parts you owned.

What you'll do

  • Own projects from brief to delivery. Turn briefs into distinctive concepts for campaigns, product launches, email, thought leadership, sales presentations, and more. Bring the same care to everyday requests, from asset updates and resizes to recurring production work. Partner with writers so the words and visuals work together for each audience and channel.
  • Explain our product and technology visually. With Product and Product Marketing, tell our product story in ways that are clear and interesting to look at. Find the visual explanation, UI mockup, or demo that helps people quickly see what Acoustic does and why it matters.
  • Make motion and video a defining part of our brand. Shape how the brand moves and create animated explainers, product videos, and social content people watch to the end. Edit interviews, screen recordings, and raw footage using tools like After Effects, Jitter, CapCut, and Descript.
  • Keep our brand fresh and consistent. Adapt our visual identity for new channels, formats, and trends while working within our brand strategy. Build templates and guidelines that help teams across the company use the brand well, and review work so everything we publish meets the same bar for craft and accuracy.
  • Create for social and the web. Design carousels, static graphics, and video for organic social that fit how people use each platform. Work with Web and Content on page designs, imagery, and reusable components that help visitors quickly understand what Acoustic offers.
  • Design for events and in-person experiences. Develop creative for booths and activations, and work with vendors on production specs. Connect each event to what people see before and after, and find ways to give the creative a longer life.
  • Use results to sharpen the work. Partner with Demand & Growth to develop and test creative for paid social, display, and other programs. Learn which ideas get the right people to click, watch, or reply, then recommend what to try next and explain
  • Improve how creative gets made. Experiment with AI tools in concept development and production, and decide where hands-on design and editing make the work stronger. Give freelance designers clear direction and feedback, work with teams across the company to clarify needs, and explain your decisions.

Requirements

You would be a great match if you:

  • Have 7+ years of experience in brand design, graphic design, or art direction, in-house or at an agency, ideally for both B2B and B2C brands.
  • Love making video, with strong motion design or editing skills.
  • Sweat the details. You have sharp judgment in typography, layout, color, and composition, and you’re fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Have helped build or evolve a visual identity, including guidelines and templates other people use successfully.
  • Can talk about what happened after the work launched, and how results or feedback shaped what you did next.
  • Use AI with judgment and can explain where it helped and where you stepped in.
  • Ask good questions, explain your work to people outside design, and handle feedback and competing deadlines without losing the details.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Designed for events, conferences, or trade shows.
  • Made complex technology or products feel clear and engaging.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology, customer engagement, or data platforms.
  • Developed and tested creative for paid social or digital ads.
  • Art-directed photography or illustration.
  • Used Claude Design or Sanity.

This role may not be a match if you:

  • Do your best work from a fully defined brief. Here, you’ll often help shape it.
  • Find it hard to let go of a concept when feedback shows it isn’t working.
  • Want the big campaign and identity work but not the everyday requests and production that keep a brand consistent.
  • Would rather not experiment with short-form video or AI tools. Both are a real part of this job.

Benefits

The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $145,000.

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-sponsored short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) program with company match
  • Flexible PTO: take what you need, when you need it
  • Parental leave: 16 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents

We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. We deliver a full spectrum of services, including advisory, analytics, optimization, and IT staffing. Our work helps organizations operate more efficiently, improve patient outcomes, and deliver measurable financial impact through smarter use of data. Through our life sciences brands, Tegra Analytics and WLH Consulting & Learning Solutions, we extend these capabilities to pharmaceutical and biotech organizations — combining data, consulting, and learning to advance commercial excellence.

jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEWThe Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA)is hiring a State Government Affairs Associate (West) to keep our reform campaigns moving across our Western states.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA)is hiring a State Government Affairs Associate (West) to keep our reform campaigns moving across our Western states. In this role, you’ll work alongside our State Government Affairs Directors to track bills, manage follow-up with lawmakers, and build materials for the 2027 sessions.

This role is built for someone who wants to win policy fights in more than one state at a time. You’ll have a hand in every Western portfolio, from digging into bill data to pitching legislators in statehouses across the region.

The ideal candidate brings three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work. This role is remote and reports to the Senior Director of State Affairs for the Western states. Expect frequent travel, especially during session.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at FGA are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five Core Values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of the following questions, you may be a fit.

1)Candid to Solve: Being willing to have tough conversations in order to solve issues and build trust.

  • Do you seek out constructive feedback—and provide it to others—to solve issues and build trust with coworkers?

2)Grow or Die: We don’t have a neutral gear; we must consistently challenge ourselves and each other to grow in our talents and skills.

  • Are you aware of your strengths and weaknesses, and do you seek out complementary skills and growth in order to mitigate your weaknesses?

3)Politically Savvy:Policy doesn’t change in a vacuum, but in a political reality that we must understand and account for.

  • Do you agree that embracing the realities of politics is necessary to change public policy?

4)Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.

  • Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?

5)Bought in to Win: We’re at FGA because we want to change policy. No one is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes, that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.

  • Do you fully support FGA’s mission and believe that lives are improved through work, not welfare, and that free markets create more freedom and opportunity than government control?

These values shape how we hire and how we work together. Expect to talk about them openly during the interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As State Government Affairs Associate (West), you will have four primary areas of responsibility:

1) Support the State Government Affairs Directors

  • Manage bill tracking, meeting follow-up, and back-end data.
  • Build and send the materials directors need for lawmakers and partners.

2) Represent FGA in the States

  • Join stakeholder and committee meetings at the direction of the Senior Director of State Affairs to advance FGA’s reforms.
  • Travel with directors on state trips to meet lawmakers and present FGA’s reforms.

3) Work with FGA’s In-State Contractors

  • Build working relationships with the in-state contractors in each director’s portfolio.
  • Join update and strategy calls and manage the follow-up.

4) Build State Plans and Session Reports

  • Work with the directors on pre-session plans for each state.
  • Draft post-session reports once the 2027 sessions close.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work.
  • Working knowledge of how bills move through a statehouse, from committee to the governor’s desk.
  • Strong communicator with lawmakers, partners, and teammates.
  • Comfortable using AI to speed up research, drafting, and data work. Quorum or other bill tracking experience a plus.
  • Live in or near the Western states region for frequent travel, especially during session.
  • Match FGA’s Core Values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION, AND COMPENSATION

FGA is seeking to fill this position as soon as possible. Beyond travel to the states, expect legislative fly-ins and quarterly team meetings.

FGA’s headquarters are in Naples, FL, but nearly all of our staff work remotely from across the country. We build our systems and culture around clarity, flexibility, and strong communication. Key elements include:

  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with FGA’s big vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the FGA team, our policies, and how we operate
  • Home office setup, including equipment and communication tools you need to hit the ground running

FGA offers a competitive salary between $90,000–$120,000, depending on experience and qualifications, along with a benefits package that includes a six percent retirement match, health benefits, and generous paid leave.

Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Lithuania

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Lithuania. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

They will help manage day-to-day operations, system modifications, and the integration of external portals and third-party applications. They will also help develop and deploy the next phases of RLF’s Salesforce implementation by scheduling meetings and tracking timelines, tasks, communications, and deliverables.

The Database Coordinator will serve as the primary point of contact for Salesforce portal functionality, troubleshooting and answering technical support questions from grants management staff, fiscally sponsored project staff, and grantees. The Database Coordinator will also coordinate with program staff on application content and requirements. They will gather feedback on portal enhancements and errors, manage vendor tickets through resolution, and lead ongoing Salesforce portal specific trainings, materials, and onboarding for RLF and FSP staff.

This position is full-time, non-exempt, and reports to the Database Manager. This is a fully remote position (8am -5pm preferred in candidate’s local time zone) with occasional travel required for meetings and staff retreats.

Duties Include:

  • Oversee day-to-day activities and management of Salesforce portals and related third-party applications.
  • Assist the Database Manager with day-to-day primary Salesforce instance maintenance including regular system updates, troubleshooting system issues, and monitoring system upgrade request tickets.
  • Maintain an in-depth understanding of data flows and systems that govern the RLF Salesforce instance and sites.
  • Work collaboratively across other functions of the technology department to align priorities, timelines, performance expectations and deliverable acceptance criteria.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate systems and external vendors.
  • Facilitate meetings between different teams and stakeholders as needed to advance initiatives and maintain alignment.
  • Create and maintain training materials, documentation, and resources to support system users including updates and new project onboarding.
  • Manage all aspects of portal user and license management including new user setup/deactivation, roles, profiles, permissions, etc.
  • Be a resource to staff on Salesforce; help troubleshoot issues.
  • Maintain procedures for system reviews, technical documentation, and data cleaning and integrity in the system.
  • Create and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards for staff usage as needed.
  • Coordinate the development of user acceptance testing and production launches.

QUALIFCATIONS

Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work and lived experiences that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

  • A minimum of 2 years as a Salesforce Administrator; Salesforce Platform Administrator Certification (ADM201) preferred. If you don’t currently hold this certification, you will be expected to earn it within your first year.
  • Minimum 2-5 years of experience managing Salesforce or CRM system.
  • Experience working at a non-profit strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with grants management systems, community sites, financial/accounting systems, and/or other databases required.

•Advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience gathering business requirements and working with a team to find the best solution.
  • Strong project management skills: ability to follow a project through from beginning to completion.
  • Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver tasks on deadline.
  • Strong verbal and written skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and explain complex issues and solutions clearly through documentation and reports. Outstanding listening skills, and ability to patiently, constructively interact with diverse stakeholders who may be experiencing challenges with the platform.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with third party Salesforce third-party applications including Form Assembly strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience with non-profit grantmaking, development, and/or program management.
  • Positive attitude and a commitment to being part of and building a positive work environment.

Commitment to Nondiscrimination

We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds. We believe that a diverse and inclusive culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

The starting pay for the Database Coordinator is $40-$43 per hour (approximately $75,000 - $80,000 annually). We have an alternate Fridays off work schedule and offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.

TO APPLY

Please provide a resume and cover letter explaining how your skills fit this position.

You'll own everything behind that moment: the real-time connection layer, the API, the job pipeline and the cloud infrastructure every device talks to. We are seeking Nigerian English Language Experts to support an AI training project focused on improving speech recognition and language understanding. Key Responsibilities

  • Listen to multi-speaker audio recordings and identify speaker and audio metadata, including dialect, accent, audio quality, background noise, age, and speaking style.

  • Ability to distinguish regional differences in Nigerian English pronunciation, vocabulary, and usage.
  • Experience with audio annotation, metadata tagging, or transcription is an advantage.
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
  • Interest in linguistic technology, AI training, or language data projects is a plus.
